Friend,

My dad used to wake me up at 6 a.m. each morning and say, "Put your shoes on, son. Get ready. There's something for you to do."
He was many things throughout his life: a veteran, a small businessman, and a preacher. He spent his days fixing junk cars that other folks had discarded – and then on Sundays, he preached to folks who felt discarded.
One of my last memories of my dad was calling him the day Barack Obama was inaugurated as the 44th president of the United States. I heard the pride and joy in his voice – the ways in which he saw the arc of history bending a little closer toward justice. Two years later, my dad was gone. As the senior pastor at Dr. King's church, I had the sad duty and honor of eulogizing him.

My father taught me so much – from the meaning of hard work to the value of serving others – and I bring these lessons with me wherever I go, including to the U.S. Senate. He's a big reason why I'm in this fight to build a better, brighter future for all people, not just the lucky few.
**But keeping up this fight in Washington won't be easy:_NPR_ is calling me one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection – in a race that experts say could decide Senate control. The only way I can fight back and defend my critical seat is if folks like you chip in now. **

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

In just a moment, I’m going to ask if you can chip in to support my campaign for Arizona governor.

But first, I’d like to tell you a little bit more about why I’m running and why this race is so critical.

I was born and raised in Arizona, and I learned the value of service at a young age, through my family and through church. I went on to a career as a social worker, advocating for women in crisis.

In that job, I met with countless Arizonans who felt like they didn’t have a voice, and that their government wasn’t looking out for them. It was clear we needed a change — but to change our government, we needed to change the people working within it. **So I ran for office — and I won.**

In the state legislature and as Arizona’s Secretary of State, I’ve fought hard to help Arizonans get ahead: expanding Medicaid, protecting the right to vote, and delivering a safe, secure election in 2020, even in the face of death threats and attacks from the far-right.

**[Now, I’m running for governor. Arizonans deserve a leader who will put their needs first — and that’s exactly what I’ll do. | | Friend, Under 50 days to flip NJ-7, flip Congress and start getting our country back on track. I have the privilege of traveling the district with Tom, meeting constituents and seeing firsthand the energy on the ground for our campaign. We hear stories of self-employed carpenters working 45+ hours a week, and their monthly costs coming in $800 higher than last year. The mom who left the supermarket last weekend with a $400 bill to feed a family of four. This is who we're fighting for, and this is the type of stories we need to change in a new Congress.

Peter,

The first time I ran for office I lost my primary, but as a product of the American dream I don't believe in giving up.

My name is Catalina, and I'm the America First Hispanic woman running for Congress in the what is now the _**CLOSEST RACE IN AMERICA-**_ the one race that will define Nancy Pelosi's legacy.

This is my first time reaching out to you, and I'm afraid of what happens if this email doesn't work.

**But I'm not afraid to tell you that I am a Christian who is Pro-Life, Pro-Family, and Pro-Law Enforcement.**

Democrats and their partners in the liberal media will tell you that someone of my ethnicity and my age can't be any of those things. They assume that I'm just a Hispanic millennial who won't challenge them on their lack of principles, platform, and patriotism.

And they're spending millions to shut me up because they know they can't take another humiliating loss from within the Hispanic community. But I refuse to be muzzled & I'll **_never_** back down from challenging the radical left on their divisive, Anti-American bullshit.

_**I will always stand up to defend our Christian conservative values, and our way of life. I will always stand up for what is right. **_

I'm not a career politician with a rolodex of corporate mega-donors. As a conservative, I'll admit that I struggle asking others for help, but I know that I have to because this race is about so much more than me.

So I'm asking you to chip in just a few bucks today to help my campaign move forward, united against the radical left and their liberal agenda. **We're so close to flipping this seat & with your help, I know we will!** ******[**CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61340892:JqW1pcV9N:m:1:3334294963:A21FD6137515E50F3DF484195E608FF7:r)****** If I can ever help you the way you've helped me, **_please_** just say the word.

God Bless America,

Catalina

Candidate for U.S Congress

clean_body: Don’t let Donald Trump and his MAGA allies get away with this | | | | | We just learned that 1,007 GOP state legislators and candidates have posed a threat to our democracy since the 2020 election – by excusing, sanctioning, or even participating in the insurrection. body:

---
Friend -- As I prepare for next week's 1/6 Committee hearing, I want to take some time this week to look ahead with you toward the future and the big picture. The threats our democracy faces are bigger than Donald Trump, and they didn't originate with him, either. While accountability is incredibly important, it would be naive to think its a cure-all. We have to address the systemic issues that are driving division, keeping Republicans and Democrats from working together, and preventing problems from being solved. [**RSVP: INNOVATIVE IDEALS VIRTUAL CAMPFIRE**](https://www.country1st.com/innovation_campfire?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_campfire_nd&n=2) That's where American innovation comes in. Americans haven't met a problem we can't solve -- we just don't always have politicians with the will to do it. And that's why I'd like you to join me to explore exciting innovations that could bring sanity to our politics, end negative campaigns, change the incentive structure for our elected officials, and lead to reasonable people of goodwill representing us to actually solve the problems that have persisted for far too long. You won't want to miss this! | [](https://www.country1st.com/innovation_campfire?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_campfire_nd&n=3 "RSVP: Innovative Ideals Virtual Campfire") [RSVP: Innovative Ideals Virtual Campfire](https://www.country1st.com/innovation_campfire?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=innovate_campfire_nd&n=3)
---
I really hope you can make it on **Thursday, September 22nd** at:
* 8:00 pm Eastern
* 7:00 pm Central
* 6:00 pm Mountain
* 5:00 pm Pacific
* 4:00 pm Alaska
* 2:00 pm Hawaii

These illuminating and hopeful gatherings are always very popular, so we hope you'll invite as many of your likeminded family and friends as possible to join us, even if they aren't members of Country First.
Send them your unique link: https://www.country1st.com/innovation_campfire?recruiter_id=91510
Aim to bring at least two more people with you (we call it **YOU+2**), which may mean inviting several more than that. The webinar will be immediately followed by breakout sessions where we can thoughtfully discuss these issues with other good folks from around the country. We want to hear what _you_ think.****
I know it's just a couple days notice, but I hope you can make it!
Country First,
Adam

name: Your America
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6086%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=U1cwU7xNI62%2btDLJY81g%2bA&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85484%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QrPRyNmtIxCbINWVCVz4Pg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85495%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uFlrIkPJIg681a0kr7F4ZA&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85495%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uFlrIkPJIg681a0kr7F4ZA&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

---|---|---|---
|
---
| | **Affordable, Christian-Based Healthcare**
---
In today's society, two undeniable constants are rising prices and attempts to remove Christian influences. While these are constant in nearly every aspect of our lives, they are especially evident in the healthcare industry. Since the passage of the Affordable Care Act in 2010, the monthly cost for membership in a healthcare program has steadily been on the rise. The rise in prices can be attributed to how the law added regulation and reduced competition, but other portions of the law also prevented insurance companies from taking religious stances in the execution of their programs. For example, insurance companies are required to pay for expenses relating to abortions, sex changes, or injuries relating to drug and alcohol abuse. Here at Share HealthCare, we're fighting back by offering an affordable and Christian-based healthcare program. We're proud to not be insurance. We're exempt from ACA regulations, which means we don't have to share the cost of those expenses that may not align with our members religious beliefs. That allows us to offer our program at a lower month cost, including $149 per month for a single, $249 per month for a couple, and $349 for a family.
---
[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2ze9nb3akk0lcuc8l9u75vt4uqtphuusaag9sbg4o_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctim1o36clh2bs)
---
But our prices are far from the only reason why our members choose Share HealthCare as their healthcare program. In the sections below, we highlight some of the other important reasons Christians all across the nation are joining Share HealthCare. You can request more information about Share HealthCare or join our healthcare community today using the buttons below!
---
| | [Request More Info](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zrk8o3585b70rl71clagt1pla0mvav6eovd15ebo_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctim1o36clh2bs)
---
| [Begin Enrollment](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zja9i0gashjh9n63v6ei9t27k09p0hpudkicmaqg_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctim1o36clh2bs)
---
| |
---
**Medical, Financial, and Religious Freedom**
---
At Share HealthCare, we believe that all Americans are entitled to the personal freedoms granted to them by God. That's why our organization is founded on the principles of medical freedom, financial freedom, and religious freedom. When you join Share HealthCare, you'll have the medical freedom to choose the providers you want to see, the financial freedom that comes with saving money with our affordable program, and the religious freedom that comes with membership in a Christian healthcare sharing ministry.
---
[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zfepmpgt7sb2eghhcsgmlc8cith12ipfp2g8pgs8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctim1o36clh2bs)
---
If you're ready to experience true freedom in your healthcare, Share HealthCare is here for you. You can request more information about Share HealthCare or join our healthcare sharing community today using the buttons below!
---
| | [Request More Info](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zleoud6upv78unh1db71qkfs61ib01f1l3k3oce0_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctim1o36clh2bs)
---
| [Begin Enrollment](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zmf0gbv878o18p27h4bdd6u3d966dm66f613d48o_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctim1o36clh2bs)
---
| |
---
| | **Our Technology Sets Us Apart**
---
One important reason our members joined Share HealthCare is our technology. We utilize a state-of-the-art online member portal that allows sharing to occur directly between members' accounts. Each member who joins Share HealthCare receives their own bank account specifically tied to their Share HealthCare membership. Each month, when a member submits their monthly contribution, that amount goes into their bank account and is then used to pay the medical bills of their fellow members. And when you submit eligible medical bills, they share into your account and your medical bills are paid directly from your Share HealthCare bank account. This means the funds are always protected and are never pooled!
---

---
You can check out the video above to learn more about Share HealthCare and how our banking technology works. If you would like to request more information about Share HealthCare or join our healthcare community, you can do so today using the buttons below!

---

Peter,

I know you're busy, but I need just a few minutes of your time.

__**[This is why I'm running.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61348391:JVLl2cV6N:m:1:3317145305:3217E8C8AF8F3675102A243312E1FF84:r "This is why
I’m running.")**__

I grew up on a small farm in Washington.

We didn't have much, but I learned the value of hard work at a young age. I learned _responsibility_. That is something that political elites will never understand.

As a former triage nurse, I have always been passionate about serving others in my community.

However, everything was tested when a suicide bomber in Iraq permanently blinded my husband, Scotty, and I was told his service was over.
_**The suicide bomber may have taken my husband's vision, but he didn 't take away our determination and drive for service over self.**_
That's how I found myself running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent because we deserve better.

With empty grocery shelves and unprecedented crime, I couldn't sit on the sidelines any longer.

_**[This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61348391:JVLl2cV6N:m:1:3317145305:3217E8C8AF8F3675102A243312E1FF84:r "This country is worth serving and
sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!")**_

I'm not asking for money. _Today, all I 'm asking for is your endorsement. _

---
| | [ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61348391:JVLl2cV6N:m:1:3317145305:3217E8C8AF8F3675102A243312E1FF84:r "ENDORSE TIFFANY SMILEY")
---

We're just weeks away from the General Election, and I know the odds are against me.

However, I genuinely believe that America needs to restore its core values. If you think that too, please, _**[endorse me and join our team.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61348391:JVLl2cV6N:m:1:3317145305:3217E8C8AF8F3675102A243312E1FF84:r "endorse me and join our team.")**_

It would mean the world to me.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

Friend,

social studies and American history textbooks aren't cutting it.
We've read them all, and what we've discovered is staggering.
Most kids' history textbooks focus on superficial facts and gloss
over the Founding Fathers' ideas that revolutionized America and
the world.

Even
worse, they don't help young readers understand why what happened
250 years ago is still relevant to our world today.

That's
why the Libertas Institute launched a 240-page American history
textbook that uses stories to share the inspiring ideas and

designed to help the rising generation connect the dots to see
how lessons learned from the past can still be applied today.

You can
see for yourself by taking a peek inside at a free chapter using
this link.

Right now
kids across the country are heading back to school. And more will
be going back in the coming weeks. It is critical that we get
this book into our schools immediately.

And I'm
really hoping I can count on your help.

Today, a
tax-deductible gift of $100 will:

Ensure that at least 10,000 students will learn from this book
within the next year.

Support teachers who want to teach true history and are
frustrated by having to use "Common Core," Critical Race Theory,
and more.
Fund
and employ a person on our team whose sole full-time job is to
get this history book-and its curriculum-into schools across the

These
kids will reach voting age before we know it. And if we don't

support policies and politicians that are at odds with freedom
and America's founding.

We can't
let that happen.

That's
why we must work fast to get this textbook into our schools as

body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zbtcthbvohb6k1kutpv4ek7mpc0suglmbpveb220_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37chieiqj6d5jmspqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sbnc5omeptgmpgm6sr6elp78opgsoq6acdi65in9d9ncir71c70cqp71pjl6grjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup76phhe2qr1ptiedj35c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6pj7cdi66pj4s8iv0)
This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhgatollokuaf07mk0p46gaatr7gadj053bo0klg_rp22sh2s8i66or6cthm8or6cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2iafcc3er4ei44pqrcrvv3q2er796d5ltk80is0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cthm8or6cjh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmread1i5buejpe4gudslamra67ggfv5ge2hqan8_rp22sh2s8i66or6cthm8or6cjh2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zt7b60sr11m9lafkr9ko9kcculjarp5vmaekt62o_rp22sh2s8i66or6cthmaoj4sph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8cdgsmq3ecr0e2rr2pbgmmrbasr0curbaptic3hjbcj369h64sj369hmep35curt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6cooj5cr56up7aphksiqjcdtgmlin49fg)
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf8h5pl0b28f9aqrso34me72fvkcniolavo5jal0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cthmaoj4sph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq6566m6vsslnpr69hvtg95onni7uag4cu8j1kko_rp22sh2s8i66or6cthmaoj4sph2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpiotjns0u56r4anmqnoncia9phi5h359c59ljl0_rp22sh2s8i66or6cthmaoj4sph2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: You may be wondering why I'm emailing
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alek For Oregon
body:
That a national political forecaster with a reputation for being unbiased, like the Cook Political Report has, would move this race in a direction favoring our campaign just three months before Election Day speaks volumes about the race we're running. . | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60803353:Wq_Or3hNa:m:1:2237666910:916E5C4417272BECF4208075A911AD24:r)
---
Peter,

We're trending in the right direction - last month, Cook Political Report moved my race from "**LIKELY DEMOCRAT** " to "**LEAN DEMOCRAT**."

You might be wondering what exactly that means, so please allow me a moment to explain the way I understand the concept. While my opponent is currently a slight favorite to win the seat, if the election were held today, the race is very competitive.

In other words, despite Oregon Democrats making this district much more Democrat friendly in the redistricting process - **they made it more favorable to Democrats by 9 more points than it was during the 2020 race** - we're still running neck and neck with my career politician opponent.

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60803353:Wq_Or3hNa:m:1:2237666910:916E5C4417272BECF4208075A911AD24:r)

Forecasts can change often, so now is the moment to act. I'm working diligently to get this race put into the "tossup" category, which is exactly where we want to be. **Earning a tossup rating from the Cook Political Report would open up new sources of funding not only from major donors across the country, but from the Republican National Committee, the National Republican Congressional Committee and others**.

**[On that note, I'm asking you to send $5, $10 or even $15 bucks to my campaign today. We'll utilize your donation to earn the support of even more upset voters who just have had it with Democrat leadership.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60803353:Wq_Or3hNa:m:1:2237666910:916E5C4417272BECF4208075A911AD24:r)**

[**HELP ME MAKE THIS A TOSSUP RACE
SEND $5 TODAY-> **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60803353:Wq_Or3hNa:m:1:2237666910:916E5C4417272BECF4208075A911AD24:r)

That a national political forecaster with a reputation for being unbiased, like the Cook Political Report has, would move this race in a direction favoring our campaign just three months before Election Day speaks volumes about the race we're running.

And now, given that we have actual evidence our message is moving the needly, **[we cannot let up](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60803353:Wq_Or3hNa:m:1:2237666910:916E5C4417272BECF4208075A911AD24:r)**. My Pelosi-endorsed opponent is going to attempt to make this race all about Donald Trump and national Republicans - we cannot let her.

With sincere thanks,

Alek Skarlatos
Republican for Congress

body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61349993:JbKp-cVNp:m:1:3345639852:2C3699B034D237ECBB6C6086573C7E6F:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Peter?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61349994:JbKp-cVNp:m:1:3345639852:2C3699B034D237ECBB6C6086573C7E6F:r "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Peter?")**_********************************************************

body:
With over 110 million Americans over age 50, it's no wonder this Princeton alum's $1 billion startup is helping people plan for a comfortable retirement.
Are you aware that you could boost your retirement outlook by using this new startup's no-cost service?
[SmartAsset's free, five-minute tool](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75f1a4838d4d423ab70bfc4538b231e3&_e=If5ctGlTqFGKyUyVAy9A4pvFvVA6wxQUlPYyZL5h8-YUpWPM8VdHM2UY4mficDC4eStLQoJSaP80GcCnn0JYNIuaEQfvbBNVcSXZtapt-P_e6OfWVO_uP6KPSa_p5BhVPA5zXooGezpQIeTJzMbAT_fIBbGNgh_Jgz3sDwfnaDL8SDd-GAGfQ-GRI3aGsFRVIpXq-MfUvoqSMTsYKx2xeebQG0xnNy58psMVjf5dulESSHdD4tWWn8D3PjuTIKLAq6HLQngC4u7g32sw8q9MD5xkgq7LrwrNXPXKSfZ_7EOdtrydEd9O4O_kGm_anu06Pr411XQc1mEdcd2KT6yeqV4aNVwcFAjYDb8DEuxx-ovtbAsvjvmj7pP3X8KqzbGFZE7aqKmggLZEHCAL1CBoE1ZjJ7G-s038PFekTKg6pss%3D) makes it easy to find qualified financial advisors in your area or who serve your area. Our exclusive tool matches you with up to three fiduciary financial advisors who have passed a rigorous vetting process.
Unlike broker-dealers, stockbrokers and insurance agents, fiduciary advisors are legally bound to work in your best financial interest.
Advisors are rigorously screened through our proprietary due diligence process.
**Why Meet With a Financial Advisor?**
It's more important now than ever to review your retirement plan with an [unbiased, fiduciary financial advisor](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75f1a4838d4d423ab70bfc4538b231e3&_e=If5ctGlTqFGKyUyVAy9A4pvFvVA6wxQUlPYyZL5h8-YUpWPM8VdHM2UY4mficDC4eStLQoJSaP80GcCnn0JYNIuaEQfvbBNVcSXZtapt-P_e6OfWVO_uP6KPSa_p5BhVPA5zXooGezpQIeTJzMbAT_fIBbGNgh_Jgz3sDwfnaDL8SDd-GAGfQ-GRI3aGsFRVIpXq-MfUvoqSMTsYKx2xeebQG0xnNy58psMVjf5dulESSHdD4tWWn8D3PjuTIKLAq6HLQngC4u7g32sw8q9MDwIlFeIIrSOsw346Zh5ZdQSt9Oyzg2S2Enw_0mFoLVe4FD7cVxAtDmLcRUWivjil6SnZTFuLgU2srpuAItVqf07NsFiXK2FRzUNoghMnr2pNZaVfyets_Mnp1FLTpjhFDTwIKRgiQDD8DVSChiou8Zw%3D). Here's why: Economic growth won't approach "normal" until as late as 2025, according to Bank of America's Chief Investment Office. This could mean your current financial plan might leave you without enough money to last your retirement.
Additionally, emotionally-charged decisions to sell off large quantities of stocks or other investments now lock in your losses, removing any chance for future growth. Research suggests people who [work with a financial advisor](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75f1a4838d4d423ab70bfc4538b231e3&_e=If5ctGlTqFGKyUyVAy9A4pvFvVA6wxQUlPYyZL5h8-YUpWPM8VdHM2UY4mficDC4eStLQoJSaP80GcCnn0JYNIuaEQfvbBNVcSXZtapt-P_e6OfWVO_uP6KPSa_p5BhVPA5zXooGezpQIeTJzMbAT_fIBbGNgh_Jgz3sDwfnaDL8SDd-GAGfQ-GRI3aGsFRVIpXq-MfUvoqSMTsYKx2xeebQG0xnNy58psMVjf5dulESSHdD4tWWn8D3PjuTIKLAq6HLQngC4u7g32sw8q9MD48ZvET7Xjb5m2TcRlDIMC8jUfvZkUb6UL3Z0OQVQvbBDSLGGCS_TXcCvO-NLeoui9uSTKkO3S8KYAQLsVo8DXUkw3re61o_ZXmS4X40lWlEpDtiYAGlTZcFdHRrWjvDV_EwdAEBB2j2Yx-oIR3s6Ys%3D) feel more at ease about their finances and could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.
Consider this example: A recent Vanguard study found that, on average, a $500K investment would grow to over $3.4 million under the care of an advisor over 25 years, whereas the expected value from self-management would be $1.69 million, or 50% less. In other words, an advisor-managed portfolio would average 8% annualized growth over a 25-year period, compared to 5% from a self-managed portfolio.
A 2020 Northwestern Mutual study found that 71% of U.S. adults admit their financial planning needs improvement. However, only 29% of Americans work with a financial advisor.
Before this groundbreaking, easy-to-use tool, there was no simple way to quickly compare financial advisors. Hundreds of thousands of smart investors and retirees have already used SmartAsset's [simple, no-cost service](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75f1a4838d4d423ab70bfc4538b231e3&_e=If5ctGlTqFGKyUyVAy9A4pvFvVA6wxQUlPYyZL5h8-YUpWPM8VdHM2UY4mficDC4eStLQoJSaP80GcCnn0JYNIuaEQfvbBNVcSXZtapt-P_e6OfWVO_uP6KPSa_p5BhVPA5zXooGezpQIeTJzMbAT_fIBbGNgh_Jgz3sDwfnaDL8SDd-GAGfQ-GRI3aGsFRVIpXq-MfUvoqSMTsYKx2xeebQG0xnNy58psMVjf5dulESSHdD4tWWn8D3PjuTIKLAq6HLQngC4u7g32sw8q9MD086rVIohYHnfupd6lCPPkQ4ea603BBl2jx5Ag9Vs8Adm5HVcaz9Kp-pfSca0IgfhJSjuWzt8zIrkP7Z6qXW3sVotXDZXm9N-JIlmoN3Kq-m5x24itMkADRo3PG6UrVPCtz-aHJMhTj7Uk7TceZM6Nw%3D) to compare their financial advisor matches.
SmartAsset works with a robust network of financial advisors all across the U.S., including individual advisors and large investment firms to cater to anyone's financial situation. CEO Michael Carvin says he expects the number of advisors to grow into the tens of thousands soon.
**How to Compare Financial Advisors at No Cost to You**
Our no-cost tool makes it easy to find a reliable, reputable advisor so you can make an informed decision and choose the right one for you. Now you can get matched with up to three local fiduciary investment advisors that are vetted and subject to our due diligence criteria. The entire matching process takes just a few minutes.
Chances are, there are several highly qualified financial advisors in your town. However, it can seem daunting to choose one.
[Click here to get started.](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=75f1a4838d4d423ab70bfc4538b231e3&_e=If5ctGlTqFGKyUyVAy9A4pvFvVA6wxQUlPYyZL5h8-YUpWPM8VdHM2UY4mficDC4eStLQoJSaP80GcCnn0JYNIuaEQfvbBNVcSXZtapt-P_e6OfWVO_uP6KPSa_p5BhVPA5zXooGezpQIeTJzMbAT_fIBbGNgh_Jgz3sDwfnaDL8SDd-GAGfQ-GRI3aGsFRVIpXq-MfUvoqSMTsYKx2xeebQG0xnNy58psMVjf5dulESSHdD4tWWn8D3PjuTIKLAq6HLQngC4u7g32sw8q9MD026Wa7lcIb7XBBE3KVV9D7HMwNoBIe2EDjv_iIAbkpaWbMg-VXuX7ItvqUnkri5WZzLM0AuLJsVaG4iJ5zUICYwbdLm-HnHmFUdKgEa0ddzGe3RtJQlBiuMonA--C3D6i5vaKjrsij-DWIynDEy-lU%3D)

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 21
CITIZENS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES STATEWIDE HISPANIC MOBILIZATION EFFORT, LATINOS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA (ATLANTA) -Today, during the first full week of Hispanic Heritage Month, Citizens for a Greater Georgia launched its effort to mobilize Hispanic voters across the state on behalf of Georgia's Republican State Senators, and Republican candidates up and down the ballot. Chaired by Republican State Senator Jason Anavitarte, Latinos for a Greater Georgia is coordinating with state and local campaigns to host a series of events in key [target districts](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ehEiRPcWE66i4NR-7beKqpw7mrmh7D18s35iULers4n-1HGD1cQcJN5ii9oVbrz1pxfiDlX4NFM5uZUbBhdh8_O5TQ3Vx9FGGCGzfmFL3UOdBN_b_GX_Jyb5862ehFPh7dZsQVrqppUMLt9OepEJneMHsd5o1ECWxHBhN4G6jhJ7Qab5zdYc_xmhx0NkAE86Idj8xAvfhUngXeP68Q-6gDJNx9QNjkbpT55gwG4-5rUeh45owDhe6-boBR3K7UOOpfID4F2jlspkvlfRnAkH7EXFlaL_YP68LWT1HIrFjH3PS08Y9uUd6xwzmvJmMdAo&c=RoJy_5R9M-i9FbUfFpVI1pGvH0XjNssoanGnZsHzPazrMKzR_Lj_ig==&ch=8lz2thwSP_Ga6hFOUTqMjJ2DczxEOdhyg2iL_QuHuzhHUWG8g2Iabg==) and counties across the state. The campaign is conducting targeted outreach by doors, phone, text, digital ads and mail, to voters including the newly registered, disengaged and disenfranchised. "Georgians, including hundreds of thousands of Hispanic voters, are feeling the pain of high prices at every turn - whether at the grocery store, gas station, or in their rent and utility bills. Under the big government, tax-and-spend agenda of the Left, they see their futures - and their opportunity to live the American Dream - slipping away," said former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. "Latinos for a Greater Georgia is helping turn that pain into power by mobilizing the Hispanic community to vote their values. Anchored by the strength of a diverse coalition, Republican voters and candidates will have the support they need to win in November and to build on Georgia's track record of conservative leadership in countering Washington's progressive agenda." Sign up [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ehEiRPcWE66i4NR-7beKqpw7mrmh7D18s35iULers4n-1HGD1cQcJLyElWwXnrulS_0jzewsND0SSKwUhl6vgsMuf8TloQW3pLWfHYOslRC08nUbIzGqAi6EP6uAI9698AQZ0ml2nmWSrtMOWExP0zzcBlv9WTCsu0dgzGD8JydJJKAd6cCR-Rryg1ADYGnhcYpUf4A6H8KM7ldqSV_3xVWX7DIbNf_L&c=RoJy_5R9M-i9FbUfFpVI1pGvH0XjNssoanGnZsHzPazrMKzR_Lj_ig==&ch=8lz2thwSP_Ga6hFOUTqMjJ2DczxEOdhyg2iL_QuHuzhHUWG8g2Iabg==) to join the coalition, and to stay updated on upcoming events in your area.

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Former FBI Agent endorses Erik
body:
...and Army Helicopter Pilot. Details inside
| | | |
---
---
| Retired FBI Agent Endorses Erik Aadland
---
|
---
| Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, was endorsed by retired Special Agent with the FBI, Kirsten Swenson.
Kirsten Swenson served in the U. S. Army as a helicopter pilot from 1991 to 1996. She was a Special Agent with the Federal Bureau of Investigation for 20 years. She managed the North East Regional Critical Incident and Employee Assistance Program worldwide out of New York City and also investigated counterintelligence matters. Kirsten also managed a horse boarding and training facility for about five years, developing an understanding of the challenges small businesses experience. Kirsten obtained an undergraduate degree from Boston University and a graduate degree from Troy State University.
---
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Kirsten said:
"I wholeheartedly endorse Erik Aadland for Congress. When I met Erik for the first time, his devotion and concern for Colorado's citizens were immediately clear to me. As a combat veteran, Erik fully understands the meaning of service to our community in fulfillment of their needs. As a retired law enforcement agent, I can rest assured Erik cares deeply about and is ready to support the men and women in blue. He will fully stand behind the protection and security of his constituents. I cannot think of a better suited candidate for Congress than Erik Aadland."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "Kirsten Swenson is an exemplary American with a long and proud history of service to community and country. Her endorsement carries all the more weight given her experience in both the military and law enforcement. It greatly encourages me to have her support. "
---
---
| |
---
---
| | [Send Erik your feedback](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kNp__fLxVZAEX8OiLrzbtZ5yYadj61_xBqD0BnpFiXtnWH2sPJKbXj1qqL-66Ndaz2GFuGe2fNCR-mT3r0vX2t-GJV3F9v2HTRrvo7G3OeqMqQD9DafCciDGjPgHOctxUR02vbQP_M6RFJCEJYKdIqtmG1iqXVEHAYqhHJz-7RfidY-dwd10s65IZPO9klF9ZKUHUXXweisOqPx9fHYD85RtASoBvBlYMayU12oeheGvBp8voqwNE1ZRCsQ3XWJMp-JKkZ4E_rc=&c=wI9OUCI2DVoBQWMtgVck_C2_R88M03t4HcLeZnIS2hVegeqYcglxDQ==&ch=HjBwTwnkV9pmnj5Yj00X5AP2aeeEZSZSpfQgZfnOSURDiVANAPJutQ==)
---
| |
---
|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no Fat-Cat donors from California and New York, or shady philanthropists backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

body:

| | | | The 2023 legislative session is quickly approaching, which means its time for the Mississippi Freedom Caucus to set our legislative goals. Earlier this year, the Caucus officers traveled to Washington D.C. to meet with State Freedom Caucus Network officials and members of the House Freedom Caucus to discuss issues that affect our nation and our state.We have identified several important areas that we believe need to be addressed by the Mississippi Legislature, but we need your opinion and your help. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is the only organized group of conservative legislators in Mississippi and our goal is to serve the people of Mississippi by sponsoring and supporting legislation that moves our state in a conservative direction.[Help set our 2023 legislatives agenda](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/JT6iOgj54P3qLlXoUdOsgA)Our identified goals are;
* Make Mississippi a sanctuary for life by introducing legislation to remove any unnecessary obstacles for families that want to adopt and foster children.**(Sanctuary for Life)**
* Bring Educational Freedom to Mississippi through comprehensive legislation that allows money to follow the student, including private and home school options, expands and strengthens Mississippi’s existing charter school laws, and ensures that parents have full transparency in what is being taught in their children’s classrooms.**(Educational Freedom)**
* The Mississippi Freedom Caucus will only support spending on core functions of government. We will actively seek to amend or defeat legislation that does not make the necessary reforms to ensure that people’s money is not being wasted. **(Oppose Wasteful Spending)**
* Finish the cleanup of Mississippi’s voter rolls and make any additional changes needed to make our state’s elections secure. **(Secure Elections)**
* Oppose any legislation or money that comes from the Biden-Pelosi-Cornyn gun control bill. We also call upon our Attorney General and Governor to reject any funding or impositions on our state sovereignty that come from this assault on our Second Amendment Rights. **(Oppose Gun Control)**
* Mississippi must ban its pension funds from being invested by companies that rely on woke Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics that prize adherence to leftist ideology over the maximum return for taxpayers. **(Oppose ESG)**
* We will oppose any attempts to expand Medicaid to provide able-bodied-adults welfare or free healthcare. **(Oppose Medicaid Expansion)**

[Rank our 2023 legislative goals by importance](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/JT6iOgj54P3qLlXoUdOsgA)

body:
|

| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than fifty days until the Election and we're falling behind our End of Quarter Goal.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.**

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346260:JFBpDcV_N:m:1:3334294963:E4D57E8221DBEEE32AABF094C8A13EBB:r "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346260:JFBpDcV_N:m:1:3334294963:E4D57E8221DBEEE32AABF094C8A13EBB:r "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346260:JFBpDcV_N:m:1:3334294963:E4D57E8221DBEEE32AABF094C8A13EBB:r "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346260:JFBpDcV_N:m:1:3334294963:E4D57E8221DBEEE32AABF094C8A13EBB:r "4")
---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61346260:JFBpDcV_N:m:1:3334294963:E4D57E8221DBEEE32AABF094C8A13EBB:r "5")
---
_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _
**This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.**
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.**If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.

Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio

clean_body: | | | | Peter, I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than fifty days until the Election and we're falling behind our End of Quarter Goal. I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much. | "2" My parents on their Wedding Day. This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize. | "1" My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation. Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated. I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...). | "3" My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000. All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted. I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did. My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me. | "4" Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family. After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support. I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream. | "5" On the campaign trail in August 2022. This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream. "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:" | | | "RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM" Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Marco Rubio | | | | | "POLLS TIED!" I'm not going to lie, this scares me. We are less than 100 days until the election and my far-Left opponent is raising millions of dollars and gaining ground in the polls. I'm sick and tired of people saying that Florida isn't going to be a tight race, because clearly, it is. This poll is the latest proof that the Democrats' plan is working. Far-Left progressive groups are pouring in millions of dollars to try to win this Senate seat. The truth is, I will lose if I don 't have your support. **Chabot Campaign’s Second TV Ad: Cincinnati Mom Says “Our Families Can’t Afford Greg Landsman in Congress”** _Mom Highlights Former Pelosi Staffer Landsman’s Record of Tax Hikes and Support for Out-of-Control Policies in Washington That Are Hurting Families_ _ _**For Immediate Release** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released its second television ad of the 2022 cycle on Wednesday. The ad, called “[Can’t Afford](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=57d19ef1c6fe4dde9785d03bacc656f1&_e=_KHcKahWPVWPzJkEbI3AAcfwf5Wmq4r_hN7WGlv1LwDwTZGgzgUODBWecxzEpul6yWoYkSHDjSYIhrwHOJRWsl8eUgS5jV0o6GebwdbabFJSHvO5xCG6MiT5fFcP1nxWY8dIGU1_8PLftQRwnh0qs7fe0pM79lmSO_eEi8sT9h5OivfMJYS7fyeQ1D0dTji8qcQVVmaC-WF5v-ldwgYu9A%3D%3D),” highlights former Nancy Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman’s record of support tax hikes on the Cincinnati City Council and support for more of the Pelosi tax-and-spend agenda in Washington that is fueling inflation and hurting families. “The Landsman-Pelosi tax-and-spend agenda pushed inflation to a forty-year high and hit hardworking families with rising costs on everyday essentials,” said Chabot for Congress campaign manager John Gomez. “That burden has been exacerbated for families living in Cincinnati by Landsman’s support for repeated tax hikes on the City Council. powerful emperors.

But
overlooked by our fascination with the might and drama of
imperial Rome is the fact that Rome reached its greatness through
a far different form of government.

Did you
know that Caesar Augustus inherited 90% of the territory of his
Empire from the Roman Republic?

The story
of how the Roman Republic emerged from a group of warring tribes
in the middle of the Italian peninsula to dominate the
Mediterranean and, later, most of Europe is a captivating
narrative of achievement, political and military genius, and the
perils of success.

To help
tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we recently
released our free online course, "The Rise and Fall of the Roman
Republic."

You can
now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the
Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or
more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of
liberty.

a limited time, we'll also send you a free color map of the Roman
world at the end of the Republic printed on high-quality paper.
This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will

Learning
the fascinating history of Rome reveals the conditions necessary
to preserve a republic...and how a republic may lose its way.
That's why we produced "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"
and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Before I
go, thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future
generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale
College!

**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**
Back on August 19 in Conroe, TX, County Citizens Defending Freedom (CCDF-USA), hosted Seth Keshel as he gave an in-depth analysis on the voter fraud that has been plaguing our country.

Captain Seth Keshel, aka Captain K, is a former Army Captain of Military Intelligence and Afghanistan veteran. His analytical method is known worldwide and has been recognized by President Donald Trump. Captain Keshel accurately predicted the outcome of every state in the 2016 presidential election. Seth is active in conservative grassroots efforts in Texas and lives in Fort Worth.

If you were there or you've ever seen Seth's presentation, then you know that the numbers don't lie.

If you were not there, that's okay - I have your six and recorded it so that you can see for yourself.

I'd like to encourage you to pay very close attention to the analysis and if you do, then you'll notice a disturbing trend!

So how do we restore Voter Confidence? I'm in agreement with the steps that Seth Keshel has outlined that must to be taken in order to ensure safe and secure elections:
1. Clean Out the Voter Rolls.
2. Ban All Electronic Elections Equipment.
3. Voter ID with Paper Ballots Only.
4. Ban Mail-In Voting.
5. Ban Early Voting.
6. Drastically Smaller Precincts.
7. Ban Ballot Harvesting.
8. Election Day is a Holiday.
9. New Reporting Requirements for Transparency.
10. Heavy Prison Sentences for all Who Commit Election Fraud.

I’m humbled to have received Seth Keshel’s endorsement and encourage you to watch the video below as he analyzes the numbers leading up to the 2020 election, as well as what he saw in the 2022 Texas primary election.

Hi, Peter.

I just got back from my trip to witness the signing of the Inflation Reduction Act into federal law. Because you're one of my strongest supporters, I want to tell you just how much this law will help each and every American in their daily lives.
Not only will this bill reduce rising consumer prices, it will also increase access to affordable health care and invest in sustainable energy systems. That means cheaper prescriptions, cheaper energy bills, fewer and less damaging forest fires, and so much more.
**This is a huge win for the American people, Peter. The****Inflation Reduction Act****includes policies I've championed for years, like lowering drug prices for seniors and** **50 million Medicare recipients.** Now, 3.3 million more Medicare recipients with diabetes will finally have access to affordable insulin – and that's just the beginning.
I'm so proud of what the Inflation Reduction Act will bring to New Mexico, and I believe that the progress Democrats have made for our country over this past year is astounding. Our country is moving forward in tremendous ways,** but ****I still need to hear from _you_ , Peter.**
**My team is running a live poll to find out how many Americans approve of this game-changing new law. You've been selected for our survey, so please answer our poll before it closes at midnight tonight:**

name: Freedom Nation Today
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cae76c4914ad426b90a0bc96108130ce&_e=_NMP3OPbgkWoEut5ivIDYcfz9NgkS5nPo4-gSgd_FTHUUtabAQ_bONH90hpQMzNmIYAQHmZ0fTuUZCiZV-CNu63PNxNWpDaEP8p7sr6VLtC0v9ixeF0sROD3oBMfsB0mDavgbduBRWsxtgWw5ONd-OdRLBUTcwzADr-tLCkX5DUpDaetJpyOSu0yh5a44iIsn_dCAXMo4lIpUT1ZVWOgvslzF0GEPfe0XxqGxTR_r9QZ1F4BmAGdI3tDEeUThO6huzZgQlMfaYAqOWsGkaFoZGxtx3cqrT1KiipH4SJkAm5F8VVuXWoGdik9UF-NtILyyyXRRlYjO3c9ZRv2H6CNs8ugcHT2t6dnIVcbOfavSOS9icxKuNk8U9kN9jgpkrT2d6gEYB2mHaPRcSs6OoSwpA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cae76c4914ad426b90a0bc96108130ce&_e=_NMP3OPbgkWoEut5ivIDYcfz9NgkS5nPo4-gSgd_FTHUUtabAQ_bONH90hpQMzNmIYAQHmZ0fTuUZCiZV-CNu63PNxNWpDaEP8p7sr6VLtC0v9ixeF0sROD3oBMfsB0mDavgbduBRWsxtgWw5ONd-OdRLBUTcwzADr-tLCkX5DUpDaetJpyOSu0yh5a44iIsn_dCAXMo4lIpUT1ZVWOgvslzF0GEPfe0XxqGxTR_r9RwiiyILJ4upXz8ShJ43YKqCNySrYFbZMVkgA8YcxHVLEff7XPO4g7cY5LGkZ8w7xtviQZsjmxQj18OIqGp-_EWOpTmUn7O0YFKyXgNNzux2KtiTK9PlEZXWDQiglCVaQDUSY_2KqZAG2fJz9cCijWL5GMbVKHmJSnKTRwlwuyOGw%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cae76c4914ad426b90a0bc96108130ce&_e=_NMP3OPbgkWoEut5ivIDYcfz9NgkS5nPo4-gSgd_FTHUUtabAQ_bONH90hpQMzNmIYAQHmZ0fTuUZCiZV-CNu63PNxNWpDaEP8p7sr6VLtC0v9ixeF0sROD3oBMfsB0mDavgbduBRWsxtgWw5ONd-OdRLBUTcwzADr-tLCkX5DUpDaetJpyOSu0yh5a44iIsn_dCAXMo4lIpUT1ZVWOgvslzF0GEPfe0XxqGxTR_r9RnOhk9Eju5aZguGala3t4K1VSj0yhCOuR1Z3CDo3gfNTf5OCbD49IsujjS9aizg4L8Wr40KYk9vq6guzM607oGuaKXmNZS3Im4t7FSy08qzjKhHYWcYShURkG_UdeY0hDG_BkBtREZ70H4ISfgtL0faoqQcNvONeOtyJTj7nZn1g%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Pro Life Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2znvtsg8lubn0q9folg4o5ltc79ub3gbo822hpjv0_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctge0pb4c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf9pdgstjr9p3mcljm6p316cqb4tr7ckp6apdjmcr3ed3kmkr66clle5jb4sjlc1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or7m9pmccbn6ko60shhcor61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zubiagp018811cjv01hhjc3ac4aq5jj79m3qojlg_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctge0pb4c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmus68skobboq6e9sf5t8r80uqnraqmv6aka3jmo_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctge0pb4c3h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zon1bgi2me9el8vilvevj0fklk2t5ohft89bovso_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctge0pb4c3h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---
