name: Ron Johnson
subject: Just your endorsement, Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

clean_body: I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. | | | | Peter, I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future. Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014. As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort. By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration. During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future. Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart. As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win. I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear. In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail. Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win. So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA. | | | "ENDORSE RON JOHNSON" Thank you, Ron Johnson | | | | "RonJon Announcement" | It's Ron Johnson. I have just announced my campaign for re-election to the U.S. Senate. I never could have imagined our country would be where it is today. From out of control spending to reckless liberal mandates, America is on the precipice of disaster. This will not be an easy win but I am ready to fight to SAVE AMERICA from the Democrats. Peter,

This should come as no surprise, but voters who are now represented by Ken Calvert in the newly-drawn 41st District are already eager to see him go.

Take a look at these highlights straight from local submissions to the _Desert Sun._
|
** "If Mr. Calvert hasn't done anything for 30 years, why would we expect him to start now?"**
\- R. John, Rancho Mirage

**"He has not been an ally of the LGBTQ community until Palm Springs became part of his district. We aren't buying it."**
\- E. Stern, Palm Springs

**"Vote no on Republican Ken Calvert this November. Yes on Democrat Will Rollins."**
\- R. Westwood, Rancho Mirage

**"Regardless of your party or inclinations, do not vote for Calvert if you believe in American democracy."**
\- M. Friedman, La Quinta

**"Democratic candidate Will Rollins can unseat incumbent Republican Ken Calvert, who voted against certifying 2020 election results."**
\- B. Wylie, Palm Springs

---

This is the first time Calvert has been vulnerable in nearly two decades. Our challenge is making sure voters everywhere know there's a viable Democrat running against him.

To continue spreading the word, we need your help on two fronts: 1.) Spreading the good word about Will’s campaign to friends and neighbors, and 2.) Helping us raise the grassroots resources to fuel our communication efforts through mailboxes, digital ads, and TV.

name: Team Slotkin
subject: The psychology of “end-of-quarter”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220921&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220921&amount=28]
Team,
You’ve heard us (and every other campaign) talk about the importance of “end-of-quarter” quite a bit.
With our final “end-of-quarter” deadline coming up on September 30th, here’s a refresher: at the end of each fiscal quarter, federal candidates are required to publicly report how much money they’ve raised, as well as how much they have in the bank. These numbers essentially provide a glimpse into how well a particular campaign is performing, and there is always a last minute push for contributions in the period leading up to the deadline.
It’s in this last minute push that campaigns tend to pull out all the stops when it comes to raising money. Some tactics are more effective than others; some try to scare the heck out of you; and some can be downright manipulative.
Trust us, we don’t like it either – but fundraising around a deadline does actually tend to be pretty effective. Unfortunately, creating a sense of urgency and continuing to up the stakes does actually get more folks to contribute. It’s gotten to the point that some campaigns will make up fake deadlines, fake consequences, and emergency-like energy in order to continue to drive that sense of urgency.
But, that has never been Elissa’s style. Which is why rather than giving you a completely made-up emergency or trying to convince you that the sky is falling, we just lay our cards out on the table, like we’re doing now. We simply give you the full context as to why these (actual) deadlines are important, and try to give you an in-depth look at Elissa’s race in the process. We also try to limit any emails mentioning a deadline to the two weeks leading up to the end of a fiscal quarter – which, you guessed it, we happen to be in right now.
September 30th is the last big deadline before Election Day, and as such it’s one of our last real chances to show what a formidable opponent Team Slotkin is. Friends and competitors alike watch these numbers and make critical decisions for the final 5 weeks of the campaign. If you’d like to help us head into the weeks leading up to Election Day strong, consider chipping in below. name: Ron Johnson
subject: Just your endorsement 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.

Ron Johnson

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zk90ofl7vi7d3mv27k7ifsi3vfacmvornn2ejmpo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq75d366gpmdcbi6or34tr4sqr7ad3nc6pm9phlcip6attksjh39ob4s5qn6dj0sv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664pb6p9nmthmcd70mdhmfc5lclp238h1e8he4933cdj6eo76c9h66oh5u)

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhpec26j98s5to872ljf7ef8b0jnie3tm9jd8u10_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhngu84jfhgqfk5bhjpp6kt1uqhulof16afpijm0_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5eaune4n5framjifjbtcgu84f8enclesp0719po_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhls4kktj85kqhcu32u996805nn10pruo5sp9ag8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvj5s61tisfispsro0f1vjeq0uighkg1bdcl2mdg_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqv6bh6cjc36n9v751an8ahpkaaemdhjic3qjpho_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zb11lng4lu9obtt4pnbh47d4o6j97pclkvonubp8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zoq06unmff1otqpuh17hdkq8hsg57k7cf4673sf8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpfai3hetlpijn8v8umo91runmvmi8s9ja550uao_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3337l3j9t1p4v9e3s0f0ie7k0d9qqmvkkg0pq7o_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrgcbskm78s0ened66c8o5a6o5064lrfufoacd90_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq8lnjcapibl6p4igajlrgh314eddqnqhqvp0bi8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zon6b911j00fbqcead7j8b5m3rivn8qa3qh9oco0_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z85fqpmn36pm4qq40pkaea3dfps6mn88hc87a4lo_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3vj3aur279eear38glb85m5r4nu5ovugvui24ig_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8qvor26vaccp8rlhebucqp0r95fa62r6tljgfe8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z96ebs4uc6tn9nj2ljhjb2uq7ca0e5cpjifsgfn8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgbv78gm4pfn8gvpdgpcv760v2tuq9e2mgism1j8_rp22sh2s8i66or6ctgecoj2cdh2bs "Step up now!")**_

---

Fellow American,

Thank you for opening this email. I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few moments in my life and my upbringing that have made me who I am today.

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=9cd9a15e34474cf4ac353950f6d375a1&_e=ujyUj-aEABixLPJeAZ8UeVIHf7Gle6JUdA_dtUQ_mfvWFgNrTvD-uxgWeDu0sf0gZVbfR_gXHSxuIRIhRKFeHDFP0z1IpGyAGVD4aGi8R61zLXhulMdt4AiwPT9SPCVy9B7EDQEGnxHe52nIN1FS7n8roO01d-uGzvVwzQH-80td7Xf8bVWAzJPdQmPzY18Iq4rvITQO9753AnRIkagOwTSuWUXkiASDGDmfDlcfb5TEdk4upS8kJvaCOJ9b5vgv3AVKnkzi6jVbMOlFmOk7OKfZW-PlmpeDM5Mas3DQr4nYWrJXvHncQMkDy2IrTKg53FJjEHbmI0bO1fEvkQw6jf8F0qx__wu3dNeByBeAyItyBjifXhehVXl9m0hmlhmcsrzgZTdeviOPoKQKY81PHm9Z8xX6vuzFN7-kk2wTmgk%3D)
This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today, **which is to put your family first, to serve your community, to be as educated as possible, and to always work hard.**

My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream.

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=9cd9a15e34474cf4ac353950f6d375a1&_e=ujyUj-aEABixLPJeAZ8UeVIHf7Gle6JUdA_dtUQ_mfvWFgNrTvD-uxgWeDu0sf0gZVbfR_gXHSxuIRIhRKFeHDFP0z1IpGyAGVD4aGi8R61zLXhulMdt4AiwPT9SPCVy9B7EDQEGnxHe52nIN1FS7n8roO01d-uGzvVwzQH-80td7Xf8bVWAzJPdQmPzY18Iq4rvITQO9753AnRIkagOwTSuWUXkiASDGDmfDlcfb5TEdk4upS8kJvaCOJ9b5vgv3AVKnkzi6jVbMOlFmOk7OBTS6aLvGiHIj1m-i0eTth3mOB8tzCNWzTnHM2wnPNlNAfKPu3ls6aHhO0GfU93_pXNit7KXyeEmOeOao0ZSsv56LbacUuS95U4T_mBO_VxTtoCxT_yTMIJ8-sntTV2dzJfGMe488XcrUJXJPkzZv8s%3D)
I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master’s degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off.

I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She supported me by working as a nurse with the State Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services so **that I could open my own business and continue my American Dream.**

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=9cd9a15e34474cf4ac353950f6d375a1&_e=ujyUj-aEABixLPJeAZ8UeVIHf7Gle6JUdA_dtUQ_mfvWFgNrTvD-uxgWeDu0sf0gZVbfR_gXHSxuIRIhRKFeHDFP0z1IpGyAGVD4aGi8R61zLXhulMdt4AiwPT9SPCVy9B7EDQEGnxHe52nIN1FS7n8roO01d-uGzvVwzQH-80td7Xf8bVWAzJPdQmPzY18Iq4rvITQO9753AnRIkagOwTSuWUXkiASDGDmfDlcfb5TEdk4upS8kJvaCOJ9b5vgv3AVKnkzi6jVbMOlFmOk7OPRkNSHJK0Y1RrzErdj7LEY1pVGGARd0voJcdB5SpoC5G8X1fhx-PojnJE7og3zNsRqi43JRyMhb9xWsV61kDGbo_F_Bzxe_PRNZSqkdIplUykJ0lF9-NV80Mv7Fq6jeJ1-xJOLs5QvcVB0ipad-62s%3D)
Since then, we have had two amazing children - our oldest is a college graduate, and our youngest is enrolled. Lisa and I could not be prouder. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; **my job as their role model is not done yet.**

I want them to see that no matter who you are and what your background is, you can achieve great things with hard work and dedication while still being able to serve the greater good and even future generations. **That is why I am running for Congress.**

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=9cd9a15e34474cf4ac353950f6d375a1&_e=ujyUj-aEABixLPJeAZ8UeVIHf7Gle6JUdA_dtUQ_mfvWFgNrTvD-uxgWeDu0sf0gZVbfR_gXHSxuIRIhRKFeHDFP0z1IpGyAGVD4aGi8R61zLXhulMdt4AiwPT9SPCVy9B7EDQEGnxHe52nIN1FS7n8roO01d-uGzvVwzQH-80td7Xf8bVWAzJPdQmPzY18Iq4rvITQO9753AnRIkagOwTSuWUXkiASDGDmfDlcfb5TEdk4upS8kJvaCOJ9b5vgv3AVKnkzi6jVbMOlFmOk7ODlrTAeS2YOG5Hwebapfo-mHq81ztlv_L581yt1vgvlETK2Tzut_nwOnAR4EkUdAI1sWV3lMUXni2mnminXjlmw1D-jSLS9dI2ZLOeoZhKSZbnqoMwBeqVmaITCzx_B-ym05gKiueRhLFtFoJV45Hf4%3D)
I have seen the mess that Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden’s policies have brought upon our nation, and I have seen firsthand the struggles it has placed on my community. **I can’t stand the fact that this is the environment our children have to start their lives in.**

Our country has lost sight of our founding principles due to poor leadership and a lack of patriotism, and I’m ready to do something about it.

clean_body: This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today. | Fellow American, Thank you for opening this email. I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few moments in my life and my upbringing that have made me who I am today. This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today, which is to put your family first, to serve your community, to be as educated as possible, and to always work hard. My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream. I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master’s degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off. I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She supported me by working as a nurse with the State Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services so that I could open my own business and continue my American Dream. Since then, we have had two amazing children - our oldest is a college graduate, and our youngest is enrolled. Lisa and I could not be prouder. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; my job as their role model is not done yet. I want them to see that no matter who you are and what your background is, you can achieve great things with hard work and dedication while still being able to serve the greater good and even future generations. That is why I am running for Congress. I have seen the mess that Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden’s policies have brought upon our nation, and I have seen firsthand the struggles it has placed on my community. I can’t stand the fact that this is the environment our children have to start their lives in. Our country has lost sight of our founding principles due to poor leadership and a lack of patriotism, and I’m ready to do something about it. | | | | | | Looking at all of these photos brought back some great memories, and I hope to keep making more in a country that we all can be proud of. ## Southern Border Is a Crisis and Disaster Demanding Action
---
|
---
| Published at [Inside Sources](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XG9hAakT9WNj9Z5oHM4t7ranZAChgh0xucqaIvdA8GMSeFYfPs87nCSFyj90Aau8LPHpTGw59w2JgP3ot1B4RzS0YlFezSAaAS-mfFJwN1GuFMg_NdNsaqOAMPZfNJXg-KIvtQMf2zW8He2WsOrQG6eWpFs5W20BtroF_D6XFp92dfPLlm1Z7mktgPBVOE7fxIjjqhrzVbvD2_-ZS84VFIJaetJPK41t&c=cr_ppxeOwCU8l_K8VxW3ZCb3bvpTt9biVOImR6fCYJVtNqwdGpDLhQ==&ch=ouXsmxbB1VNLOSvtQ8RjmqVjfQnweAr7RDnu9tcZBIw_7k7VVo8UGw==) on Sep 20, 2022 written by Erik Aadland
---
| | |
---|---
|
The southern border has become a humanitarian disaster affecting the nation. This situation requires an immediate and effective federal response.

While we can feel compassion for those seeking a better life, we must also recognize that unfettered access to this country is not compassionate as it has created conditions for massive human and illicit drug trafficking, leading to enormous suffering. Furthermore, it threatens our national security.

No other nation in the world allows such unrestricted immigration.

We must take the following steps to rectify this situation while implementing balanced, compassionate immigration reform.

--Finish the wall. A wall provides a measure of control that no amount of electronic surveillance can. We have only 19,000 border agents, and there is no way to control every mile of the border with agents alone. When appropriately resourced with personnel and technology, the wall is an effective deterrent.

--Reinstate the Stay-in-Mexico policy. The policy was better for America and those seeking to immigrate here legally. The United States decides who has access; at the same time, immigrants should be given a clear, understandable and swift process for immigration.

--Deport any undocumented immigrant convicted of a felony. Following punishment, send the offender back to his or her country of origin. The United States should not bear the burden of felons who are here illegally.

--Make fines for employers of undocumented immigrants higher and more enforceable. We should do what we can to disincentivize employers who illegally lure in workers.

--Establish sound and reasonable work visa regulations with clear reporting requirements.

--Eliminate social services paid for by taxpayers for undocumented immigrants. Staying in the country must require following the law. American citizens should not bear the burden of those here illegally.

--Assist Mexico, Central America and South America with creating thriving economies and harmonious societies built on the rule of law. Relations with such nations must de-incentivize illegal border crossings and include plans to cripple cartels enriching themselves from human suffering.

Though the vast majority of illegal immigrants are people who are merely seeking a better life, there are thousands of hardened criminals or bad actors who must be prevented from entering.

Lax border policies allow easy entry for individuals from countries worldwide, including terrorist elements. Increasingly belligerent nations such as Russia, China and Iran are exploiting open borders. Have we so soon forgotten the attacks of 9/11?

President Biden's policies encourage drug cartels to build ungoverned empires along the southern border, championing evildoers who have no respect for human life or our nation's sovereignty over the well-being of American citizens.

Seemingly beneath our noses, the federal government is conducting middle-of-the- night secret transportation of illegal immigrants from the border to every state without consent from state authorities. It is no longer surprising to see undocumented immigrants sneaking across backyards or ranches [after crossing the border](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XG9hAakT9WNj9Z5oHM4t7ranZAChgh0xucqaIvdA8GMSeFYfPs87nCSFyj90Aau8hlO0yHnJPtlOpfMP41FijYBTPhXTeIXEF2RqvcPiIeqVv2ZfUqDaYd3zJ3gFhib4sIUTVcdfqM-c9CK0ox4BUde3VitKpIjWtg5DVbEHom228hrISQjlC5VJ0ptMcUcwvf5quqxKmaSlk8QGEnT68ZPjNbKCTOfOPBumRb4ZFfaYAzBPz4MIQ1EBTwqOynz5JdcpyWld_etX7I0__xD95G5crSq5N4m_wVVOhn-tl1GSXc0AFfPtOvP7vRhRoKrM&c=cr_ppxeOwCU8l_K8VxW3ZCb3bvpTt9biVOImR6fCYJVtNqwdGpDLhQ==&ch=ouXsmxbB1VNLOSvtQ8RjmqVjfQnweAr7RDnu9tcZBIw_7k7VVo8UGw==).

Furthermore, the U.S. is using taxpayer dollars to spend on health and welfare for undocumented immigrants when such support escapes our own citizens. name: Team Graham
subject: What they are saying...
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Team Graham, Inc
body:
...about the Protecting Pain-Capable Unborn Children from Late-Term Abortions Act introduced by Senator Lindsey Graham. | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805679:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r)
---
**_What They're Saying_ about the Protecting Pain-Capable Unborn Children from Late-Term Abortions Act introduced by Senator Lindsey Graham**
**[Congress Should Work to End Infanticide in America](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805680:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r) By National Review Editors**

A 15-week limit stands in stark contrast to congressional Democrats' radical federal legislation that would effectively allow abortion in all 50 states through all nine months of pregnancy. But some congressional Republicans are now balking at Graham's bill. Why? They suggest they believe abortion might be an issue exclusively for state legislatures, but their recent votes suggest they don't really believe that.
...
For nearly a decade, Graham has been the lead sponsor of a similar late-term abortion ban (one that established a limit at 20 weeks after conception) that has had almost unanimous support from congressional Republicans. When the Senate voted to advance the 20-week bill in 2015, 51 Republicans and three Democrats supported it.
...
We are persuaded that the undoubted federal power to defend basic civil rights under the 14th Amendment extends to this issue, as Republicans have held in their platform for decades.

* * *

**[When Did the GOP Become Pro-Choice?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805681:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r) By Jon Schweppe**

The 15-week bill checks all the boxes: it is morally righteous, constitutionally mandated, politically winning, Supreme Court-approved, and strategically savvy. The Republican Party has pledged to support a bill like this for the better part of four decades. Nearly every sitting Republican member of Congress has already co-sponsored this kind of bill in prior terms. In 2020, 53 Senators voted in favor of a 20-week ban with these same exceptions. Nobody said anything then.
...
Abortion is going to be a major issue in this election cycle. Dobbs happened, and there is no avoiding it. This is now a prisoner's dilemma. Republicans have two choices: they can ignore the issue and lose badly (which most of the establishment seems committed to doing), or they can counter the left's attacks and run against the left's own abortion extremism. If done even half-heartedly, this is a draw. If done emphatically, the polling suggests it turns into a win.
...
So, the GOP has to talk about abortion. That's the only play. The Democrats have already committed to spending tens of millions of dollars running on this issue in November. That's why Graham's bill is so important; it insulates Republicans and gives them the opportunity to support an easily defensible policy position. Abortion restrictions after 15 weeks, especially with the exceptions, are extraordinarily popular. Meanwhile, nearly every single Democrat is on the record supporting a 40-week bill, a position that is completely untenable with the American people.

If voters are choosing between 15 weeks with exceptions and 40 weeks without limits, we will win this debate easily.

* * *

**[Lindsey Graham's Bill is a Good Start](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805682:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r) By Erick-Woods Erickson**

I understand the argument of leaving this to the states, but Democrats have already said if they get back the Senate with a few more seats, they will scrap the filibuster to impose abortion on demand. The GOP needs a response.
...
Graham's position is moral, responsible, and reasonable. It gives Republican candidates a piece of legislation to point to that they support and shows how unreasonable Democrats actually are. It forces Americans to decide if they're comfortable killing a child who can feel the pain of the procedure.
...
You and I can say this should be a state issue. Democrats intend to pre-empt every state's laws. They will make it a national issue. We might as well accept the reality of the situation instead of the wishful thinking of the world we want, which is not the world in which we live.

* * *

**[In Defense of Lindsey Graham](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805683:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r) By Rich Lowry**

The South Carolina senator proposed a national restriction on abortion that has popular support and that could represent a defensible consensus GOP position.
...
If the worry is that Democrats will use the Graham bill to hit Republicans on abortion - they are already hitting Republicans on abortion. As a POLITICO report noted, there's not much space for the bill to show up in Democratic ads given that the spots are already overwhelmingly about abortion.

In other words, Republicans can't escape this debate. To the extent they try, Democrats will define them as favoring the most radical measures. And the Graham bill shouldn't qualify. Since it is a prohibition on abortions after 15 weeks, it would only ban an estimated 5 percent of abortions. It has exceptions for the life of the mother and rape and incest.
...
If Republicans truly believe that they can't defend a 15-week ban, maybe they are right to find any excuse to try not to talk about the issue of abortion. But that path leads, ultimately, to implicit surrender. You can't blame Lindsey Graham for wanting his party to do better.

| [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805684:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r) | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805685:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r) | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805686:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r) | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60805687:W_3Nw3hNC:m:1:877327319:235C5F92DEE90074A747B72FF8590DAD:r)

WEEKLY UPDATE:

7 WEEKS UNTIL ELECTION DAY!!

Karina has a packed schedule again this week and would love to see you all at an event or two.

Here is what is coming up this week....

FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 23rd

Friday Night Lights

High School Football Game Tailgate - West Potomac vs Mount Vernon: Sep 23 @ 6:15 - 7:45pm at Mount Vernon High School, 8515 Old Mt Vernon Rd, Alexandria. The game starts at 7pm. WE NEED PARENTS of Mount Vernon and West Potomac to help us by introducing Karina to other parents and passing out literature. If you are available, please email Volunteer@KarinaForCongress.com.

Super Saturday Door Knocking: Sept 24 @ 9am - 12:30pm at 1135 Neal Dr, Alexandria. Hosted by Sue Bradley. Wear your Karina t-shirt, neat comfortable clothes, and a smile! Some campaign shirts are still available. Come with the Campaign Sidekick app downloaded. Refreshments, training, and support provided. WE NEED DOOR KNOCKERS. We’ll team you up with an experienced volunteer if preferred. Door Knocking is the most effective use of your volunteer time! Please let us know you are coming so we can make sure we have a mentor for every new knocker, RSVP: https://tinyurl.com/9-24Doors

Clarendon Day: Sept 24 @ 11am - 6pm on Clarendon Rd near the Clarendon Metro Stop. WE NEED VOLUNTEERS to help man the booth in 2 hr shifts. RSVP: https://tinyurl.com/ClarendonDayBooth

[https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/RQEwXNQm-TdcAhrdYjIMdfH7rluM4r_cWePmnQbiDvKdq3JDjAAjKKKqIt_P89Haw94sj2NK7PRx38ase9d3LL9vDShaBBom-RCvCZCjx5FWBtIzZZC9Zf0S6HEwLXU0M3Av5e7x8M2lvYfviCPwCjk3YtsMdxpRhJi5A6iNI4ysW0cFI9X5aSdj1A]

Sign Blitz & Pizza Party: Sept 24 @ 11:30am - 4pm. Start at one of 3 locations, place signs around the district, then celebrate with Art Levine at a Pizza Party! Wear your Karina t-shirt and help us place signs around the District. WE NEED VOLUNTEERS to place signs in public spaces, and WE NEED VOLUNTEERS to request signs for their homes. RSVP: https://tinyurl.com/SignBlitz

[https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/f-EWNlMTtAIeEZK1TRlSlE3OOGD6hSUFnEG-ESoksu3MWGrUxtscrDnVwwoM6c409xf1LW0vrGnTCYoJuahGV0NFaew1T6gSWcinajLEdxcTdFSwRTUzI_VK4_lhddGFTBfZUN9268ECvzoFufPjHvLZaGETN09tW1tQkx-I19W4B6ZF7QSQ5O0tfg]

SUNDAY, SEPTEMBER 25th

Pimmit Hills Day: Sept 25 @ 11am - 2pm at Olney Park. Join the Pimmit Hills Civic Association for a fun picnic. Wear your Karina t-shirt and visit us at our booth. See event details on their Facebook Page: https://fb.me/e/1HHxgBYOL

SUNDAY, SEPTEMBER 25th

Chili Cookoff w/ Colonial Mt Vernon RW: Sept 24 @ 4-8pm at Pohick Bay Regional Park, 6501 Pohick Bay Dr, Lorton. Come taste all the different chilis and pick your favorite one. Karina will be speaking!

[https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/EBXFI8Om3lXuvlFU2ZPk-LZx-v_c6IjZUL-Mr--sItwWee5sQHiosAo21FgeiLqu_9fLwgFhnfMzFFLjWar4mwZa0mdVNlXlaSFe3gXcFWp2UBuv17CYK3u23tpavHiKa0Mo8NhbmMAV-kRcR-LW1NO1M8-XGZV985YGX6i12n05aYCnmbqp5EQlHQ]

SUNDAY, SEPTEMBER 25th

Conversations With Karina

Small Business Solutions: Sept 25 @ 5:30pm - 7pm at Rincome Thai Cuisine, 3030 Columbia Pike, Arlington. Hosted by the Asians For Karina Coalition. Cost: Free. Let us know you are coming! [https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/lrsV9kKJA18YIYQGbPyiVwqgkXR5pFSkOpQsmbfZNQAW8VDqQ82oQM_dWHGR5gTkVJ3KoMbqs4qwTmFsdHGLBtWTkUSMuGstJhhzevzd-AXdsWOnO9kDTBHW9ZZVC76DybXsrbD_rLtzYflaho_uzFT6uBoq0lAO7TR2dewojphK7xaCEiUO2X9EEg]

body:

Peter,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what's never going to change.
**__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357053:Jfxe_cVN9:m:1:3331421248:3B4EACB2C52F076EBA1471D91EB59361:r)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired woker would like you to believe.

**__So, what 'd I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357053:Jfxe_cVN9:m:1:3331421248:3B4EACB2C52F076EBA1471D91EB59361:r)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357053:Jfxe_cVN9:m:1:3331421248:3B4EACB2C52F076EBA1471D91EB59361:r)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children. **

That won't change, I'd rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I've given you my story in a nutshell, I'm going to humbly ask for your support. I've got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I need you to rush whatever you're able below to make sure I have the resources necessary to fight for you and defend our nation.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357053:Jfxe_cVN9:m:1:3331421248:3B4EACB2C52F076EBA1471D91EB59361:r)** | [**DONATE $500**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357054:Jfxe_cVN9:m:1:3331421248:3B4EACB2C52F076EBA1471D91EB59361:r)

God Bless,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357053:Jfxe_cVN9:m:1:3331421248:3B4EACB2C52F076EBA1471D91EB59361:r)

Peter,

I don't look like a politician or speak like a politician. I don't even dress like a politician.

Maybe that's why all the politicians and their powerful allies in Washington are spending millions of dollars each week here in Georgia to attack me, smear my name, and prop up my opponent, Democrat Senator Raphael Warnock.

We have not been able to respond with many of our own ads because we don't have enough money. **[To defend myself with the truth, I need my closest friends and strongest supporters in my corner. Can I count on you, Peter?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61356148:JlB5_cVkN:m:1:3253819041:79BC5E81597B6D79EC3366E9FD859534:r)**

[**Donate $25->**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61356149:JlB5_cVkN:m:1:3253819041:79BC5E81597B6D79EC3366E9FD859534:r) [**Donate $50->**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61356150:JlB5_cVkN:m:1:3253819041:79BC5E81597B6D79EC3366E9FD859534:r) [**Donate _More_ ->**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61356148:JlB5_cVkN:m:1:3253819041:79BC5E81597B6D79EC3366E9FD859534:r)
**Unlike many of these professional politicians, I've had to work harder than most everyone else just to get to where I am today.**

I spent fifteen years playing professional football in the USFL and NFL. After leaving the gridiron, I leaned on my faith and my family to help make changes in my life that would lead to success off the field.

I built one of the most successful minority-owned food service businesses in the country. Believe me when I tell you that in a lot of ways, it was harder work than playing in the NFL. I hustled day and night to get the company off the ground, traveling the country, selling chickens. I worked trade shows, drove thousands of miles, missed too many flights to count, and slept in an airport or two along the way.

Peter, this Senate race is no different. I knew it wouldn't be easy, but that's the way I like it. I've been practicing, studying, training, and working my whole life. That's how you rise. That's how you win. And this race is too important to lose.

Peter, these next 49 days will decide it all - whether America continues down this dangerous path - or charts a new one. **[I know times are tight right now, but your investment today of $25, $50, $75, $100, or even $250 will pay huge dividends on Election Day.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61356148:JlB5_cVkN:m:1:3253819041:79BC5E81597B6D79EC3366E9FD859534:r)**

This race is going to be a bumpy ride. They're coming after me hard, and they'll come after you, too. To win this race, I'll take the hits for both of us. Because that's what teammates do.

Thanks,

# **Emilia Sykes Releases Second TV Ad: “Flying”**

**_Attack Ads Backing Her Opponent Will Fail To Distract From Sykes’
_****Record of Cutting Taxes, Raising Pay and Keeping Ohio Families Safe**
---
| AKRON, OH — Democratic congressional nominee Emilia Sykes released “Flying”, her second**** television ad of the general election. “Flying” sends a clear message to voters that no**** matter how much her opponents try to twist the truth and launch false attack ads against her, it won’t distract from Emilia’s record of raising wages and cutting taxes for Ohio’s hard working families and fighting to keep us safe. "What Ohioans need now is a leader who is focused on serving our community, not spreading**** lies,” **said Sykes**. “I’m proud of the work I’ve done with both sides of the aisle to deliver real**** results for workers and families here in our community, helping to strengthen their safety and their financial security. When elected, voters can trust that I’ll continue to always continue to put our community first.” Click [HERE](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=d4a0a8d89b&e=7730fa895a) to watch “Flying”
---
| [ ](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=c9fc982dc6&e=7730fa895a)
---
| Transcript**:** In**** elections, you know the routine. The other side will make up lies about me, and they'll put them on air. They're hoping you'll forget that I worked with both parties to raise pay, keep us safe and cut taxes. And they definitely don't want you to know that I have a plan to lower costs and keep more money in your pocket. They'll twist everything to scare you. But the only thing that will stick is my landing. I'm Emilia Sykes, and I approve this message.
The OH-13 congressional race is a highly competitive matchup between Sykes and radical far-right extremist Madison Gesiotto Gilbert, who recently [doubled down](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=510d8de6a2&e=7730fa895a) on her anti-choice extremism and [was caught violating ethics laws](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=107f63cea1&e=7730fa895a) by failing to file her financial disclosures. ** ** ###
---
| **About Emilia Sykes**
Emilia Sykes is the State Representative for Ohio’s 34th legislative district. Born in Akron and raised on the city’s west side, Emilia has worked tirelessly to keep jobs in our state and expand opportunity for working families in Northeast Ohio. As House Minority Leader she worked with Republicans and Democrats to deliver real results for Ohio’s families, businesses, and seniors.

Emilia will bring a fresh perspective to Washington, and fight for opportunity for every child, senior, and family in Northeast Ohio, regardless of their politics or beliefs.

Learn more about Emilia Sykes at [www.EmiliaSykesforCongress.com](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=6877563dc6&e=7730fa895a). That starts with supporting the Democratic National Committee before the midterm elections in just 48 days. So I’m asking: You haven’t chipped in yet this year. Can I count on you to be one of the supporters we need from Manassas to make a $7 donation to the DNC? Midterm elections are historically challenging for the party in power, but after seeing record job growth, record low unemployment and Democrats' Inflation Reduction Act becoming law in these past few weeks , we’ve seen a lot of Democratic enthusiasm that bodes well for us in the upcoming midterm elections. We need to keep it up and ensure we’re investing the appropriate resources over the next 48 days to elect Democratic candidates across our country who are committed to building a better America for all families. $7 or whatever makes sense for your budget will make a far greater impact now than that same amount given in the final days or weeks leading up to Election Day. You’ve probably heard of Margaret Thatcher. But do you know the story of mom Cindy Warmbier who became North Korea’s worst nightmare, or school choice champion Virginia Walden Ford? Have you heard of civil rights pioneer Claudette Colvin? These extraordinary women inspire me — especially when people tell me I can’t or shouldn’t do something. I want you to be inspired, too. [**That’s why I wrote my new book, “If You Want Something Done...”**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=fe9f806808944ddda3b171cd6e37d6d8&_e=kBvNCKDRE-6aaR_yrLaHB3aI1c4q77W0Mk8wzYiwif_4ZV4lKK9QWzftaoUcj-WJ0heLs-vv94A3-pjfCE31LUIzDB7OUKNuNO018E7CP0urooMe8412iC9VKP2UbypvNg08JByF9ZnvPvSToNQ83m8Wafz8VJ3fmBScE0zY228cGYYS4R6Q980-xWF4a6IFYKYmAeM1GZSyOINL7JOHbjmzHsqprU7dZJYEMmJoSBKsX00qnNWsau7bymJU4ptH4K3Iw54p-GMBZmePUCiC-Q%3D%3D)**** It looks at the lessons we can learn from some of the incredible women who changed history. [**I hope you pre-order your copy of my book and learn why their stories matter.**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=fe9f806808944ddda3b171cd6e37d6d8&_e=kBvNCKDRE-6aaR_yrLaHB3aI1c4q77W0Mk8wzYiwif_4ZV4lKK9QWzftaoUcj-WJ0heLs-vv94A3-pjfCE31LUIzDB7OUKNuNO018E7CP0tHLcRuvt4CpvBuenMBP7PaL1cDbugLM7JHjUlLJN2cCJhtVzp8E2Nkw8VdNNmvjHJezg4dkFGnGw4O-bKHYx7bnjua6bDyQTITM-JMlWchez4ubLeWuQacUIjNQpUZrbTYCr9kwhISbwcBdHDCPzkAGTVCmgEf5BaRmGJPqN9hRA%3D%3D) And when you do I hope you see yourself in these women and their greatness. Big news – Doug’s birthday is tomorrow!

name: Derek Kilmer
subject: Now is the time to rebuild
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
Finding enduring and innovative solutions together
Peter,

We've seen more and more conflict. More and more division. Not only in our politics but in our communities too.

In an _NBC_ poll earlier this year, 70% of Americans agreed with the statement: "America has become so polarized that it can no longer solve the major issues facing the country -- and that those differences will only continue to grow."

We're not being honest with ourselves if we don't acknowledge that there has been an upswing in real, tangible divides among the American people - including among folks in our own state and district. We've seen conflict that has affected our faith communities, that has arisen when people go to the gym to work out, and even within neighborhoods.

**That 's why I was honored to lead my colleagues - nine Democrats and nine Republicans - in introducing the Building Civic Bridges Act.** This bill would set up a new pilot program, led by AmeriCorps, to focus on supporting civic organizations and spaces dedicated to revitalizing civic culture and bridge-building across our nation.

**[People want progress for our nation and region- not political games or partisan extremism. If you agree that we work better when we are united, add your name next to mine to become a citizen co-sponsor of the Building Civic Bridges Act.](https://act.myngp.com/el/ffecQMsFjtvOxUBhPJEazwT-9L0y_u7ZbNDS6Mb8wCc=/saAIW-VKAo3pn9bnX7MsjYZigmTFk7Zc2md7oK6gbeU=?ms=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&refcode=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&source=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://act.myngp.com/el/ffecQMsFjtvOxUBhPJEazwT-9L0y_u7ZbNDS6Mb8wCc=/saAIW-VKAo3pn9bnX7MsjYZigmTFk7Zc2md7oK6gbeU=?ms=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&refcode=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&source=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})
One of the fundamental pillars that makes up a healthy democracy is the ability to have disagreements, both big and small. But part of what has ensured that we remain a functioning democracy is our ability as Americans to find our way back together in order to find solutions that work for all of us. In fact, last week I joined President Biden at the White House for the United We Stand Summit to emphasize that very point.

I have hope in the work of community, faith, and civic leaders. We have what it takes to resolve some of the polarizing conflicts plaguing our nation.

**[If we're going to confront our nation's challenges, we need to work to find enduring and innovative solutions - together. Add your name to support the Building Civic Bridges Act.](https://act.myngp.com/el/ffecQMsFjtvOxUBhPJEazwT-9L0y_u7ZbNDS6Mb8wCc=/saAIW-VKAo3pn9bnX7MsjYZigmTFk7Zc2md7oK6gbeU=?ms=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&refcode=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&source=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220921_cvcbrd_adv_gq_act___dk_ettx&utm_medium=email&em={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&fn={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&ln={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&pc={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&contactdata={{ContactData}})**

As always, it's an honor to represent you,

Derek

**Derek Kilmer is leading the efforts to reform our democracy and break through the partisan gridlock so that Congress works for the people. Chip in today to support his grassroots campaign.**

I want to bring my skills as a fighter, a litigator, and a negotiator to the halls of government. As lieutenant governor, I want to champion women’s rights, make sure our kids have access to the best education possible, and provide high-quality health care to everyone, especially our veterans.

Under McMaster, our state isn’t living up to its full potential. We have leaders who are rejecting lifesaving Medicaid funds just to score political points, taking away women’s freedom to do what they want with their own bodies, and leaving our children behind in their schooling.

McMaster’s obsession with expanding the abortion ban is an insult to women of our state. If I can be trusted to fly combat missions, why can’t I—or any women—be trusted to have control over our own healthcare decisions?

**We’re about to have a change in leadership. But only if we keep the pedal to the metal.**

subject: This is a long, but very personal message

body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "I went on to play
soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "Scotty was
severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s
first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "In 2007, we
welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61357229:6q5h5cVNo:m:1:3253819041:76B8A5261DCC94841482F8FB8E02BF27:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

She has actual plans to address the most important issues and the experience to get those plans enacted. ** In the last six years, things have not gotten better. The overdose and housing crises are worse. Climate change is getting worse. The current administration has blocked efforts to remedy these disasters. Brenda is running to make sure we solve the issues most important to Vermonters. | It’s a tough race, but when Brenda slept on the statehouse steps for 28 days, most people thought they could not win. | | | Did you miss Governor DeSantis' urgent message the other day, Patriot?

you to contribute $15 today, Patriot?")_** We know the value of a dollar means something different in Biden's America, but every contribution given in the next 60 minutes ensures that our voices are heard, and our country's future is protected.

Please don't wait and step up now!

Good evening Peter,
My name is Commissioner Aaron “Adot” Whitely. I'm reaching out to you as an Army combat veteran who deployed in support of Operation Enduring Freedom (OEF11-12) with B Co. 2nd Battalion 5th Infantry Regiment as part of 3rd Brigade, 1st Armored Division.
As a Chatham County Commissioner and a public servant, I am proud to help launch Veterans for Wade.
If you have served – you know what our service means to our families and ourselves. We’ve served in our military for many reasons: a sense of duty, to make a better life for our families, to ensure our freedoms aren't taken for granted, or a combination of all of those things.
I know that Wade holds those same reasons in mind in his quest to serve the citizens of the 1st District. He will not only represent veterans with the honor we deserve, but he will represent us as colleagues of his father, who served as a captain in the Army.
I believe Wade is prepared to stand for us veterans and not buckle to political rhetoric or pressure.
If you have served and believe the 1st District deserves new representation, join our Veterans for Wade effort today. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/HVVyrjc8iEe65laL3YBEDg2]
Join Veterans for Wade ➞ [https://secure.ngpvan.com/HVVyrjc8iEe65laL3YBEDg2]
“When we send our men and women in uniform into threatening situations, the least we can do to honor their service is to ensure they receive the support they deserve." - Wade Herring
Please share this with any interested friends & family. We will contact those who sign up to share our upcoming veterans events in support of Wade.
Your support is appreciated.
Thank you,
Commissioner Aaron “Adot” Whitely
Chair | Veterans for Wade
If you want to support our Veterans for Wade outreach efforts, please make a contribution here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/veteransforwade?refcode=whem0919]

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: My least favorite part of the job
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Susan Wild for Congress
body:
Peter, my least favorite part of campaigning is how much money it takes to win a race — especially in a battleground like Pennsylvania.

To be frank, it takes a lot of money to get our message out to voters on the airwaves and online. It takes a lot of money to travel around the Commonwealth and make sure voters can share their stories with me. It also takes a lot of money to hire organizers who will knock doors and help Pennsylvanians make a plan to vote.

Every dollar will make a difference in a race this close — and this important. Can you rush any amount right now to help this team win and to help Susan Wild stay in Congress?

$3 (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-swc-shapiro-2022?refcode=BLU-SWC-20220921-1-EM&amount=3)

$5 (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-swc-shapiro-2022?refcode=BLU-SWC-20220921-1-EM&amount=5)

OTHER AMOUNT (https://secure.actblue.com/donate/blu-swc-shapiro-2022?refcode=BLU-SWC-20220921-1-EM)

It’s even more important that we have the resources we need to run a winning campaign in a competitive state.

Races here have come down to the wire in recent elections: Joe Biden won Pennsylvania by just 1% in 2020, and Trump won here in 2016.

Polling in this race has been up and down for the past few months, so we need to use every single tool at our disposal if we want to win. But it takes money to persuade voters, turn them out on November 8th, and reach them in every corner of Pennsylvania.

I’ve told you before how I hate asking for money, but it’s something I unfortunately need to do to give us a shot at winning this consequential race. Can you donate whatever you feel is right to support my campaign and Susan Wild’s re-election ahead of our critical end-of-quarter deadline? name: Tony Evers
subject: I’m calling a special session to help restore reproductive freedom
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
body:
This morning I called a special session because Wisconsinites deserve to have a voice when it comes to the future of abortion policy in our state. | Derek,

On the ceiling of the Governor’s Conference Room in the Capitol is a phrase I’ve often repeated over the last three years: “The will of the people is the law of the land.”

Well, right now, the will of the people isn’t the law of the land when it comes to abortion rights in Wisconsin -- but it damn well should be.

That’s why I’m calling a special session to create a pathway to repeal the 1849-era criminal abortion ban, by putting it on the ballot in a statewide referendum.

Wisconsinites deserve to have a voice when it comes to the future of abortion policy in our state. I’m fighting like hell to make sure they get it.

[Derek, let’s make sure radical Republicans hear the will of Wisconsin voters loud and clear. Add your name to let the GOP know you stand with me and support this Special Session and my efforts to defend reproductive healthcare freedom in Wisconsin.](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1707?refcode=TE_EM_EN_3MU_20220921_1_1&t=5&akid=4865%2E1827488%2EUH2IyQ)

| ****[TAKE ACTION](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1707?refcode=TE_EM_EN_3MU_20220921_1_1&t=6&akid=4865%2E1827488%2EUH2IyQ)****
---

The way I see it, Wisconsinites should have the right to make their own reproductive healthcare decisions without interference from politicians -- it’s a fundamental freedom that shouldn’t even have to be put to a vote.

But Legislative Republicans have left us no other choice. If they aren’t going to uphold the will of the people, then the people deserve the right to take a stand at the ballot box.

At the end of the day, Wisconsinites -- and women in particular -- were not only stripped of their reproductive rights, but they currently don’t even have a way to enact the necessary change to restore their freedom without permission from the Legislature.

[I call that bullshit, folks. It’s time for us to change that. Add your name to join me and tell the GOP that Wisconsin voters must be given the opportunity to decide the future of abortion rights.](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1707?refcode=TE_EM_EN_3MU_20220921_1_1&t=7&akid=4865%2E1827488%2EUH2IyQ)

Onward,

Tony

Hey Peter, it’s Mark Takano. Corporate and billionaire checks have long influenced our elections, often while hidden in the shadows.

Hello friends,

My name is Jim Obergefell, and I’m the Democratic candidate for the 89th
district of the Ohio House of Representatives. Admittedly, that’s probably
not why my name sounds so familiar.

I was the lead plaintiff in the 2015 Supreme Court case Obergefell v.
Hodges, which recognized marriage equality for same-sex couples throughout
the country.

But thanks to an extremist Supreme Court packed with Trump-appointed
far-right judges and the current 50/50 make up of the Senate, marriage
equality is once again at risk.

When the Supreme Court struck down Roe, Samuel Alito name-checked several
landmark cases, including the decision to legalize same-sex marriage,
potentially putting it on the chopping block.

If we’re going to protect same-sex marriage, we need to do so through

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Our opponent in her own words:

name: Mandela Barnes
subject: I am writing to ask you to split a $5 contribution between my campaign and Cheri Beasley's campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Here are a few things Cheri Beasley and I have in common:
#

Hi there, friends. It's Mandela Barnes – I'm the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin.
Here are a few things Cheri Beasley and I have in common:
* We're both running to flip Republican-held Senate seats from red to blue.

* We're both up against millions of dollars in outside spending from Republican dark-money groups.

* We both have the opportunity to make history as the first Black U.S. Senators from our respective states.

* And we're both facing a very important FEC fundraising deadline on September 30.

Our campaigns are relying on a very large number of grassroots donations in order to stay on track to meet our goals before this FEC deadline.
**These goals are not arbitrary. They're what we need to raise in order to win Wisconsin, win North Carolina, and expand the Senate majority.**
We simply cannot afford to come up short, which is why I need to ask you today:
[**Can you please split a $5 contribution between my campaign for Senate in Wisconsin and Cheri Beasley's campaign in North Carolina? Your donation will be put immediately to work winning these races and expanding the Democratic majority in the Senate.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-barnes-split.9-mn43&refcode=em220921-2-subs&t=1&akid=1799%2E357359%2ErV9vB6)
_If you've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your split contribution between Cheri Beasley and Mandela Barnes instantly._
| | **[Donate $5](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/3792?c0=cb-em-barnes-split.eAvZXw&refcode=em220921-2-subs&refcode2=1799.357359.rV9vB6&t=20&akid=1799%2E357359%2ErV9vB6)**
