---
****
| | **[Donate $100](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2570?c0=cb-em-barnes-split.RxWiOX&refcode=em220921-2-subs&refcode2=1799.357359.rV9vB6&t=24&akid=1799%2E357359%2ErV9vB6)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2573?c0=cb-em-barnes-split.EOWnIl&refcode=em220921-2-subs&refcode2=1799.357359.rV9vB6&t=25&akid=1799%2E357359%2ErV9vB6)**
---
****
When you look at the Senate map for 2022, there are very few states where Democrats have a realistic opportunity to win Republican-held seats.
Two of those states are North Carolina and Wisconsin.
So if you've been wondering how you can best make an impact in this election, look no further than these two Senate races. It is hard to overstate just how important North Carolina and Wisconsin will be to determining whether Democrats will expand the Senate majority.
If Cheri and I can count on your support, we are going to be in a strong position to flip these seats and win historic victories. It will only happen if we're in this together, so I'm asking one more time:
[**Will you split a $5 contribution between my campaign and Cheri's campaign? Let's turn Wisconsin and North Carolina blue and expand the Democratic Senate majority.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-barnes-split.9-mn43&refcode=em220921-2-subs&t=26&akid=1799%2E357359%2ErV9vB6)
It means a lot to know that Cheri and I can count on people like you when it matters most.
Thank you for splitting a donation between our campaigns today.
All my best,
Mandela Barnes

Fellow American,

Thank you for opening this email. I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few moments in my life and my upbringing that have made me who I am today.

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=e8631f1a0ce54b498090af739bd2eeea&_e=D7-NKldOQ2-LjsEDHjIOaNwD0zRlUh4elGtbHc7mXKWEQt7IwJ91EJmzKxDC-q5fCbO32VoA08My8aRhcCFntfQ3fhhqE95uLuKpvMNJN9RUqVHEdA4rVULzp7lH0hc8dTb8xeujMLKjk7VWNGLIy3cJdkqhL-oaqN9oSsqwx4X70HvroAr3zj0CKuMqw_3yDBcwOlRBryiaUxfIqft_aumoYnFIsfIuC0ZvdlHq5Wx5RB8u3moO5k3lPy6mGKVqy0QIHtinFIbzd3Op_-VOEjq7VFOyabcvohlJWC2GMuoYEAWi3E45A23Ot6bEuguV-B8nPewjE7Y3dSIPvy6naJith3kQojYUSrdRHoTI17N6q-QthGumrSBsEzATReWoGb9BwybqlonUXmys9Jbif-e7PbOqH1Ce1gh23x8AHBA%3D)
This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today, **which is to put your family first, to serve your community, to be as educated as possible, and to always work hard.**

My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream.

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=e8631f1a0ce54b498090af739bd2eeea&_e=D7-NKldOQ2-LjsEDHjIOaNwD0zRlUh4elGtbHc7mXKWEQt7IwJ91EJmzKxDC-q5fCbO32VoA08My8aRhcCFntfQ3fhhqE95uLuKpvMNJN9RUqVHEdA4rVULzp7lH0hc8dTb8xeujMLKjk7VWNGLIy3cJdkqhL-oaqN9oSsqwx4X70HvroAr3zj0CKuMqw_3yDBcwOlRBryiaUxfIqft_aumoYnFIsfIuC0ZvdlHq5Wx5RB8u3moO5k3lPy6mGKVqy0QIHtinFIbzd3Op_-VOEigVwxNCP9juQFe0lWr4knoe9YpK2n9xsIgXVdS3zjOrxLlO-RmbAkrQZUl6IPp2p0RXSAe5y0TMzv4JS63sg4kcCFebW17WxynTwIg1faoyZONmLRu7AE3MVZ197o7Az5KmunxEOJ4nDNUGN1HLfN0%3D)
I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master’s degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off.

I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She supported me by working as a nurse with the State Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services so **that I could open my own business and continue my American Dream.**

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=e8631f1a0ce54b498090af739bd2eeea&_e=D7-NKldOQ2-LjsEDHjIOaNwD0zRlUh4elGtbHc7mXKWEQt7IwJ91EJmzKxDC-q5fCbO32VoA08My8aRhcCFntfQ3fhhqE95uLuKpvMNJN9RUqVHEdA4rVULzp7lH0hc8dTb8xeujMLKjk7VWNGLIy3cJdkqhL-oaqN9oSsqwx4X70HvroAr3zj0CKuMqw_3yDBcwOlRBryiaUxfIqft_aumoYnFIsfIuC0ZvdlHq5Wx5RB8u3moO5k3lPy6mGKVqy0QIHtinFIbzd3Op_-VOEmltMot8_JBCX6QPGWiyEW8h_94FZ7pcNe691TnrksmfqYDzTO0u31N85ybiIoqzaOFXX1MJBUEamZbo2T3z6zHU-k4v8Wlscci1uWZsu71glO_UNbOxPZxYKRbavtLL_MS_S_8milvGZaui6aIog0c%3D)
Since then, we have had two amazing children - our oldest is a college graduate, and our youngest is enrolled. Lisa and I could not be prouder. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; **my job as their role model is not done yet.**

I want them to see that no matter who you are and what your background is, you can achieve great things with hard work and dedication while still being able to serve the greater good and even future generations. **That is why I am running for Congress.**

[](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=e8631f1a0ce54b498090af739bd2eeea&_e=D7-NKldOQ2-LjsEDHjIOaNwD0zRlUh4elGtbHc7mXKWEQt7IwJ91EJmzKxDC-q5fCbO32VoA08My8aRhcCFntfQ3fhhqE95uLuKpvMNJN9RUqVHEdA4rVULzp7lH0hc8dTb8xeujMLKjk7VWNGLIy3cJdkqhL-oaqN9oSsqwx4X70HvroAr3zj0CKuMqw_3yDBcwOlRBryiaUxfIqft_aumoYnFIsfIuC0ZvdlHq5Wx5RB8u3moO5k3lPy6mGKVqy0QIHtinFIbzd3Op_-VOEhECMabVqpPwdsCCMLBdAlP7WJIsL0LNjFXasmyPiGfx-XQ1r2WM5hXQZsdH_pp2sjBItp4-8oCL4HDAFcQno878wRCDMKCHl3csmCrzaNnH0N7ml5eC_UCb5xxBJgmCPzYIzgH3WF82b-Ga4B7ovBA%3D)
I have seen the mess that Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden’s policies have brought upon our nation, and I have seen firsthand the struggles it has placed on my community. **I can’t stand the fact that this is the environment our children have to start their lives in.**

Our country has lost sight of our founding principles due to poor leadership and a lack of patriotism, and I’m ready to do something about it.

clean_body: This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today. | Fellow American, Thank you for opening this email. I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few moments in my life and my upbringing that have made me who I am today. This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today, which is to put your family first, to serve your community, to be as educated as possible, and to always work hard. My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream. I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master’s degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off. I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She supported me by working as a nurse with the State Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services so that I could open my own business and continue my American Dream. Since then, we have had two amazing children - our oldest is a college graduate, and our youngest is enrolled. Lisa and I could not be prouder. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; my job as their role model is not done yet. I want them to see that no matter who you are and what your background is, you can achieve great things with hard work and dedication while still being able to serve the greater good and even future generations. That is why I am running for Congress. I have seen the mess that Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden’s policies have brought upon our nation, and I have seen firsthand the struggles it has placed on my community. I can’t stand the fact that this is the environment our children have to start their lives in. body:
Thank you for being on this team.
#
Hey Derek, I’m going to get personal real quick... and don’t mind if I get a little misty-eyed while I tell you about this. 🥲
Something you might not know is that I ran for this same U.S. Senate seat in 2016. We didn’t even win the primary, but I’m still so proud of that campaign we ran together.
Deciding to run for office, especially for a seat as important as this one, can be a difficult decision. Even among my family, I made sure Gisele + the kids were on board with this, because we knew it wouldn't be easy.
The press scrutinizes every move I (and even my family) make. The GOP continues to spend millions of dollars on ads that lie about who I am + what I stand for. Even Dr. Oz has used the fact that I had a life-threatening stroke against me — something no legit doctor would do, btw.
But despite politics being “icky and dirty,” as Gisele would say, you’ve been there by my side. And that means more than you will ever know, Derek.
Every single time one of yinz or youse chips in, it’s a reminder that this campaign is truly people-powered by all 67-counties. Together, we’ve built a record-breaking grassroots movement. And because of your support, I know that we’re going to make a real difference for working families everywhere this November.
**[Which is why I have to ask: Can I count on you to make your first $5 donation today? Our campaign wouldn’t be here breaking records if it wasn’t for folks like you chipping in when you can.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220921-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220921-7337&refcode2=7337_434096_-jgzKs&akid=7337%2E434096%2E-jgzKs)**
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220921-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220921-7337&refcode2=7337_434096_-jgzKs&akid=7337%2E434096%2E-jgzKs)**
At the end of the month, when my finance team submits our final quarterly finance report of this election, I would be honored to know your name is on it, Derek.
But even if you can’t give right now, know that I am so proud to have your support. I hope I make you proud in return.
— John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they've been stuck with for _**years**_.

It's time for a change in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be neck and neck, and I'm getting nervous. We're finally closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

Can you endorse my campaign to help me take the lead to save Washington?

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

#### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq**

**PRESS RELEASE**
Release Date: September 16, 2022

Title: ‘Enough is Enough’: Haneefah Khaaliq Declares Write-in Candidacy for Indiana U.S. Senate Race in [Short Documentary](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=3060a4a6d7&e=a49cb82bb3)

It's not politics as usual. Haneefah Khaaliq, a former school teacher and lawyer, began her campaign for U.S. Senate in Indiana in 2020. After venturing out to collect 4,500 signatures as required by the State of Indiana to remain on the primary ballot, Khaaliq’s signature collection was challenged by the close friend of a primary opponent. In Indiana, if a candidate's signatures aren't challenged, candidates are presumed safe and allowed to run. Amongst other things, the court filings allege that a staff member of the Commission was contributing to a main primary opponent's campaign and that Khaaliq was given just 5 pages of evidence to review before the Commission hearing, but during the hearing, was presented with nearly 300 pages of evidence with no time to review the evidence (Case Number: 22A-EX-00509, Indiana Court of Appeals). On June 17, 2022, the Indiana Court of Appeals refused to hear the case for lack of jurisdiction. Khaaliq alleges she was steered to file in the wrong court by the Commission staff. On September 15, 2022, the Indiana Supreme Court also denied review. On September 20, 2022, Khaaliq filed again in the Marion County Superior Court. Khaaliq's only option to continue in this year's senate race was to run as a write-in candidate. Khaaliq is the only woman left standing in Indiana's U.S. Senate race and the first African-American, and first African-American woman to run for U.S. Senate in Indiana's general election. "Someone once said when injustice becomes law, resistance becomes duty," Khaaliq said. She continued: "The late RBG once stated that women belong in all places where decisions are being made. I believe that for all people. All people need representation. I would've had no problem bowing out of this election cycle, but not under these conditions. Enough is enough!" In Indiana, write-in instructions must be provided when there is a verified write-in candidate for all forms of voting including by paper, electronic, or absentee ballot. Supporters may choose their party as usual and either write or type in: Haneefah, Khaaliq, H.K., or Haneefah Khaaliq in the space provided for the U.S. Senate. Questions? Contact your local county voter registration office. Problems at the polls? Dial 866-461-8683 or 317-999-5592. Visit haneefahkhaaliq.org for more information! View the full documentary on YouTube. Write-in instructions are also provided on the homepage at haneefahkhaaliq.org.

They instilled the very values I live by today. | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6e98a505b65644739f25ca4997391bf7&_e=o7Ld3SgmRKsxUueZwWNXf4FoGseDXsoQQsVQ8R2pQw_zQfhlJuwABUiqu3Bkn4w6KeffRE1bE9TgNsCyautt2lZnA99GM5gud3I8mKLOZw8j68swaDic0dRmj26a7YdioeUiivBl1ocCFRGcqIrSeSLJAKDHOwHbX0l8AWTkTBYDQcUe9l54aP-xbOdF1fkSmEXuRHrbGNNlu-mbvTlrtFS75e6xZ66mCbjAIsJvj1a72kVRCFJoKg8tBgsDr-R7eFyil30hxORGDWQ5Re3A8TnDtGHR0lTgyUsFScpKbKIhtZi7L9za_63QPqrIU9CeQ-BwGPV7fWlJOmvJjxtL46MnuM2AVdHlPHTz_XPS8sSpUizIW4-uSKEQLRdTqL5xA4La3U_mkJvoLBJprLSHoZiWB5z16iAPywZkSwwIEJrVi_z5UIklJWYuJxzcdhPjcc3zpl8grQWpPCPQJpMNLQ%3D%3D)

Peter,

Thank you for opening this email. I wanted to take a few minutes to share a few moments in my life and my upbringing that have made me who I am today.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6e98a505b65644739f25ca4997391bf7&_e=o7Ld3SgmRKsxUueZwWNXf4FoGseDXsoQQsVQ8R2pQw_zQfhlJuwABUiqu3Bkn4w6KeffRE1bE9TgNsCyautt2lZnA99GM5gud3I8mKLOZw8j68swaDic0dRmj26a7YdioeUiivBl1ocCFRGcqIrSeSLJAKDHOwHbX0l8AWTkTBYDQcUe9l54aP-xbOdF1fkSmEXuRHrbGNNlu-mbvTlrtFS75e6xZ66mCbjAIsJvj1a72kVRCFJoKg8tBgsDr-R7eFyil30hxORGDWQ5Re3A8TnDtGHR0lTgyUsFScpKbKIhtZi7L9za_63QPqrIU9CeGIW79H1dY5u7RTiJZ6qPYKX9BIyeus2aWnwS6r5i1Esvt172Qy8-xse2XrHgYxdwpoTPbysP0m9hEzsw1JKltCz-mngdzJbniX5bvp6GdfBoaP6iLM4ZhCVHlblnR2qBVaiLp51mWIHxQTFUZ_dw5Q%3D%3D)
This is a photo of my mom and dad. They instilled the very values I live by today, **which is to put your family first, to serve your community, to be as educated as possible, and to always work hard.**

My parents came to this great nation to live out their American dream. They worked day and night at factory jobs and office administrative work to ensure I was getting the education to land a better job so that I could pursue my American dream.

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6e98a505b65644739f25ca4997391bf7&_e=o7Ld3SgmRKsxUueZwWNXf4FoGseDXsoQQsVQ8R2pQw_zQfhlJuwABUiqu3Bkn4w6KeffRE1bE9TgNsCyautt2lZnA99GM5gud3I8mKLOZw8j68swaDic0dRmj26a7YdioeUiivBl1ocCFRGcqIrSeSLJAKDHOwHbX0l8AWTkTBYDQcUe9l54aP-xbOdF1fkSmEXuRHrbGNNlu-mbvTlrtFS75e6xZ66mCbjAIsJvj1a72kVRCFJoKg8tBgsDr-R7eFyil30hxORGDWQ5Re3A8TnDtGHR0lTgyUsFScpKbKIhtZi7L9za_63QPqrIU9CecFTzgQ0rMGUC9MXgevxGalPdi70YRzmTbuenlUK-Zk3S7QQWAQ7sPQ65F4oq4W7IMWPH26CbK8mV_tjkCTEfd9ze2l7zkrek7yQfe_QN1A_w3IYMWh4VSCBnjIJgo0VvamQgW9zWVCQw2spbXXDhcA%3D%3D)
I am a first-generation college graduate, and I even earned my master’s degree. I had to take out a good amount of student loans, but as my parents taught me, my hard work would pay off.

I soon met my wife, Lisa, and we fell in love. She has always been my rock. She supported me by working as a nurse with the State Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services so **that I could open my own business and continue my American Dream.**

[](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=6e98a505b65644739f25ca4997391bf7&_e=o7Ld3SgmRKsxUueZwWNXf4FoGseDXsoQQsVQ8R2pQw_zQfhlJuwABUiqu3Bkn4w6KeffRE1bE9TgNsCyautt2lZnA99GM5gud3I8mKLOZw8j68swaDic0dRmj26a7YdioeUiivBl1ocCFRGcqIrSeSLJAKDHOwHbX0l8AWTkTBYDQcUe9l54aP-xbOdF1fkSmEXuRHrbGNNlu-mbvTlrtFS75e6xZ66mCbjAIsJvj1a72kVRCFJoKg8tBgsDr-R7eFyil30hxORGDWQ5Re3A8TnDtGHR0lTgyUsFScpKbKIhtZi7L9za_63QPqrIU9Cev-xZ17qB2hzxBTg_Z6x2JKzfL4ZMSbzC_NaIuGe3i79KSUVkeYzXRvhJqzZnsjg0ILyGRyvQUQUUp2u2J8pUocapk8EC2CTEFU_rzqT_JNv-Rrzgz_u3Nu1HkddFE2ckmEa1VqhlefhKZp2cCukORg%3D%3D)
Since then, we have had two amazing children - our oldest is a college graduate, and our youngest is enrolled. Lisa and I could not be prouder. But my goal is to continue making them proud of me; **my job as their role model is not done yet.**

I want them to see that no matter who you are and what your background is, you can achieve great things with hard work and dedication while still being able to serve the greater good and even future generations. **That is why I am running for Congress.**

| | Friend, I’m Taylor Pansing Brooks — Patty’s son and a proud LGBTQ+ Nebraskan. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51092880/368261860/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220921_fromtaylor_rs4&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220921_fromtaylor_rs4&refcode2=adf3fc6b-f939-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZGYzZmM2Yi1mOTM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D7NoNU_9nBZvL6Rc4jQX51WNsYMJWtjmplWeCtx2Gsw=) I wanted to reach out because frankly, it’s **unconscionable** that our legislators continue to vote against what _should_ be our most fundamental human right: _The right to love whomever we love._ Nebraska hasn’t always been kind to our LGBTQ+ neighbors, and I’m grateful every day that I grew up in a family that has loved and accepted me every moment of every day, without reservation. Over the last eight years, my mom has fought fiercely on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature for people like me to live and love without fear of discrimination — at work, in our communities, and in the privacy of our homes. She knows that being gay, or bi, or trans, or gender nonconforming, isn’t a _choice_ — **it’s simply who we are.** The _choice_ lies in whether we come out as our true and authentic selves, or if we continue to suppress the most inextricable parts of our identity because it makes some of our elected officials uncomfortable. **People like Mike Flood are voting to keep us in the shadows. I say it’s time to rise up and vote him out of office this November.** | [VOTE FLOOD OUT THIS NOVEMBER »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51092881/368261861/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220921_fromtaylor_rs4&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220921_fromtaylor_rs4&refcode2=adf3fc6b-f939-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZGYzZmM2Yi1mOTM5LWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D7NoNU_9nBZvL6Rc4jQX51WNsYMJWtjmplWeCtx2Gsw=)

Nebraska hasn’t always been kind to our LGBTQ+ neighbors, and I’m grateful every day that I grew up in a family that has loved and accepted me every moment of every day, without reservation. Over the last eight years, my mom has fought fiercely on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature for people like me to live and love without fear of discrimination — at work, in our communities, and in the privacy of our homes. She knows that being gay, or bi, or trans, or gender nonconforming, isn’t a choice — it’s simply who we are. The choice lies in whether we come out as our true and authentic selves, or if we continue to suppress the most inextricable parts of our identity because it makes some of our elected officials uncomfortable. People like Mike Flood are voting to keep us in the shadows. I say it’s time to rise up and vote him out of office this November. | = My mom has dedicated her career to ensuring all Nebraskans can enjoy our state’s promise to equality before the law. name: Team AOC
subject: Hurricane Fiona
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We’re asking this movement to step up again to help provide urgent relief in the aftermath of Hurricane Fiona.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220921-3412-header&t=1&akid=3412%2E2526796%2ECauTOX)
Over the weekend, Hurricane Fiona devastated the island of Puerto Rico and continues to make landfall throughout the Caribbean.
On Monday, the entire island of Puerto Rico went dark when damage from the hurricane shut down their vulnerable electric grid. People have lost their lives and millions are still without power and running water (and could be for a long time).
This blackout and devastation comes almost exactly five years after Puerto Rico’s power grid was devastated by Hurricane María in September 2017, leaving many residents without electricity for months.
[While we work for long term solutions, we’re asking this movement to step up again to help provide urgent relief in the aftermath of this disaster. Can you make a $3 donation to Vamos PR to support on-the-ground relief?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220921.y4_AAJ&refcode=em20220921-3412-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3412%2E2526796%2ECauTOX)
**[Support Puerto Rico Relief →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220921.y4_AAJ&refcode=em20220921-3412-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3412%2E2526796%2ECauTOX)**
_Nuestra Escuela is the fiscal conduit who will be providing support with Vamos PR to nearly two dozen organizations. 100% of your donation will go to[this coalition](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220921.y4_AAJ&refcode=em20220921-3412-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3412%2E2526796%2ECauTOX) of grassroots partners on the Island, addressing immediate humanitarian need. _
Puerto Ricans are still recovering from the trauma and devastation from Hurricane María. So much of the devastation we’re seeing right now from Hurricane Fiona is from years of inadequate response compounding – most significantly since 2017 when María struck.
So much has not been restored and was not properly addressed from Hurricane María during the Trump Administration.
In order to respond to this crisis and prepare for the future, it is going to take a large amount of investment. What we’re witnessing now are the unaddressed consequences from the previous catastrophe. Puerto Rico cannot wait, we must take action now.
**We need to authorize funds immediately, and use this as an opportunity to fund a just transition on the island** – not just try to build things back the way they were. We must make major investments in bringing power lines underground, making sure we’re funding renewables, community solar cooperatives, and more.
[Please chip in today to help support urgent relief efforts and we’ll be in touch again soon with more ways you can help. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220921.y4_AAJ&refcode=em20220921-3412-P_FND_CHA_DIR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=3412%2E2526796%2ECauTOX)
Together we raised $5 million for Texans after a winter storm devastated their grid, let’s step up for Puerto Rico too.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220921?refcode=em20220921-3412-P_FND_CHA_DIR&t=6&refcode2=3412_2526796_CauTOX&akid=3412%2E2526796%2ECauTOX)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220921-3412-P_FND_CHA_DIR&t=7&akid=3412%2E2526796%2ECauTOX)**

Fellow patriot,

If you take a moment to listen to the mainstream media talking heads or read opinion pieces in left-leaning newspapers, there is a good chance that if they reference Texas in a story it’s likely they’re trying to get the reader to buy into the narrative that Texas is on the cusp of flipping Democrat in the near future and that Republicans are doing everything in their power to stop the inevitable.

**But that couldn’t be further from the truth.**

As you may know, 2022 marks the second election in a row that I’m running to represent Texas 15th Congressional District in the U.S. House– **which since 1903 has only ever elected Democrats as federal representatives in Washington. **

Here are five reasons you need to pay attention to my congressional race deep in the heart of South Texas:
1. **In 2020, I ran against a Democrat incumbent no one thought I could beat; while I came up short, I only missed the mark by 6,588 votes – or 2.8%**
2. South Texas shifted more dramatically toward Trump than any other region in the United States in the 2020 election. The counties comprising the Rio Grande Valley are home to communities that are almost entirely Hispanic.
3. **Despite what national Democrats want people to believe, Hispanics in South Texas support border security, in spite of being labeled as “self-hating” by angry leftists.**
4. Democrats look at Hispanics through a single lens, whether they’re trying to court Mexicans in Los Angeles or Puerto Ricans in New York. South Texas is neither.
5. **Tejanos (as we call ourselves in South Texas) are culturally conservative; There is nothing conservative about today’s Democrat Party.**

clean_body: From The Desk of Nikki Haley | Friend, As Republicans, we need help in the next midterm elections to take back the House and Senate from the Democrats. We've all seen the damage they've done in just a few months, and we need to do everything we can to stop them in their tracks. They have the smallest majority in modern history, which means they will do, and spend, anything they can to try and keep their power. We need to ensure that Republicans have the resources they need to make major gains and restore sanity to Washington. An important part of achieving our goals as Republicans is supporting patriots, like my friend Senator Chuck Grassley. That is why I am writing to you! We must stand for the conservative principles we believe in. The best way to do that is to support conservatives with the courage and principles to take on the far left in Washington. | My very best, Nikki R. Haley Paid for by The Grassley Committee, Inc. Right now is a moment when we need folks like you to come through for our campaign. We noticed a bit of a fundraising slow down this past week during our budget meeting, and honestly, it was a bit concerning.

| | | | | Peter, **_A former Special Forces General turned radical right-wing Senate nominee for the GOP from New Hampshire has a plan to end our democracy._** **_Think I'm being hyperbolic? Don Bolduc, a full-on MAGA-Republican fascist, called on Americans to "rejoice" when Roe V. Wade was overturned, and he'd fully ban abortion. As Democratic, pro-choice Senator Maggie Hassan--whom we MUST reelect!---put it at the time:_** “He said he would vote for any anti-choice legislation in the U.S. Senate, and that he would never compromise,” **It's chilling.** [**Can you join Blue Amp Action in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Senator Maggie Hassan to protect abortion and voting rights?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc8672a08-9ce4-4091-815c-719063c3b752/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _But, his position on the U.S. Senate may be even more terrifying. He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.**The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money.**_ So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. **_It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE_. **

He's quietly, along with right-wing cranks, pushed for the repeal of the 17th Amendment.The 17th Amendment gave Americans the ability to elect Senators in their states a century ago, because in another period of vast corruption, progressives knew state legislatures--who picked U.S. Senators at the time--were easily bought by big money. So, progressives passed the 17th Amendment. And much like getting rid of Social Security or abortion rights, even talking about repealing the 17th Amendment was a fringe, fever swamp idea for the 20th and early 21st Century. But, now, it's championed by the insane Bolduc, and others. It is not hyperbole to say if the 17th Amendment were repealed DEMOCRATS WOULD NEVER AGAIN CONTROL THE U.S. SENATE. | | | | | | This would ensure that along with the bias towards small states (ie Wyoming having as many Senators as California), monied interests who've already bought state legislators would get to pick Senators in larger states where they've gerrymandered Democrats into a minority (see Ohio, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Texas, etc). Meanwhile, Maggie Hassan is one of the most forceful voices on codifying Roe, protecting women's rights and ensuring MORE PEOPLE VOTE, not fewer like millions fewer as Bolduc wants. We must defeat Republicans in November. We must, in particular, defeat dangerous extremist Bolduc and reelect Senator Maggie Hassan in New Hampshire. We not only need this great Senator in the Senate, but her seat could decide whether we remain in the majority or Mitch McConnell becomes the new Senate leader. Thank you for keeping up the fight! body:
| Peter – my opponent, Don Bolduc, was just asked a question about the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ and the threat of a national abortion ban.

**His response? Women need to “get over it.”**

Truth be told, this isn’t surprising. On the day _Roe_ was overturned, Don Bolduc said Americans should “rejoice.”

**But we are not rejoicing. We’re not going to “get over it.”**

We’re going to fight back, stop a national abortion ban, and show anti-choice Republicans what happens when you try to take away the rights of half the population.

clean_body: Unlike many of these professional politicians, I’ve had to work harder than most everyone else just to get to where I am today. | Peter, I don't look like a politician or speak like a politician. I don't even dress like a politician. Maybe that's why all the politicians and their powerful allies in Washington are spending millions of dollars each week here in Georgia to attack me, smear my name, and prop up my opponent, Democrat Senator Raphael Warnock. We have not been able to respond with many of our own ads because we don't have enough money. Unlike many of these professional politicians, I've had to work harder than most everyone else just to get to where I am today. I spent fifteen years playing professional football in the USFL and NFL. After leaving the gridiron, I leaned on my faith and my family to help make changes in my life that would lead to success off the field. I built one of the most successful minority-owned food service businesses in the country. Believe me when I tell you that in a lot of ways, it was harder work than playing in the NFL. I hustled day and night to get the company off the ground, traveling the country, selling chickens. I worked trade shows, drove thousands of miles, missed too many flights to count, and slept in an airport or two along the way. Peter, this Senate race is no different. I knew it wouldn't be easy, but that's the way I like it. I've been practicing, studying, training, and working my whole life. That's how you rise. That's how you win. And this race is too important to lose. Peter, these next 49 days will decide it all - whether America continues down this dangerous path - or charts a new one. This race is going to be a bumpy ride. They're coming after me hard, and they'll come after you, too. To win this race, I'll take the hits for both of us. Because that's what teammates do.
